# Annexe D — Instance `HandlePool` (non normative, contrat de bibliothèque)

Cette annexe décrit une **instance de bibliothèque** de la discipline MM-03, et non une nouvelle opération primitive du langage. Les noms sont sémantiques. Le contrat doit être reconstruit et vérifié ; les résultats du jalon 3 concernent le modèle exploratoire et ses conditions, **pas** automatiquement les règles corrigées ci-dessous.

## D.1 — Identité, état et stockage

Un handle est une donnée `(poolId, slot, gen)` **sans autorité d'accès intrinsèque**. L'identité logique `poolId` est fraîche et n'est pas réutilisée pendant l'exécution pertinente : détruire puis recréer un pool à la même adresse ne réactive pas un ancien handle. Chaque pool vivant conserve une entrée abstraite `{storage, internal, slots}`, où chaque slot possède `{place, gen : Nat, live : Bool}`. Les slots sont des sous-emplacements deux à deux disjoints, inclus dans `storage` ; leur métadonnée abstraite est représentée en octets par l'implémentation de bibliothèque.

`storage` peut être local, statique, alloué ou être un bloc issu d'une arène. **`newPool(storage, internal)` exige que toutes les feuilles du stockage d'entrée soient `Uninit`** et doit vérifier la garde unifiée de MM-03.3 §2.7 bis sur les deux registres des abstractions vivantes. Il reprend les autres obligations applicables de `newArena` sans fabriquer ni droits ni initialisation des valeurs de slots. Les entrées libres sont `Uninit` ; leur génération initiale est zéro. Une autorité ne peut être `internal` de deux abstractions vivantes, et une arène ne peut réutiliser l'`internal` d'un pool vivant.

## D.2 — Emprunt composé et résolution

Une résolution réussie dérive **de `internal` une autorité compagne** couvrant toutes les feuilles du stockage du pool, de mode `Observe` ou `Modify`, puis dérive **de cette compagne** une autorité de même mode par entrée résolue. L'autorité d'entrée est une descendante de la compagne, et non une autre dérivation indépendante de `internal`. Les deux sont soumises aux règles ordinaires de modes effectifs, d'exercice, de détention, d'ancrage et de transfert ; aucune permission nouvelle n'est créée.

`resolve(h, Observe | Modify)` vérifie l'identité de pool, la génération et la vivacité du slot **avant toute création d'autorité** : handle d'un autre pool, périmé, slot absent ou libre ⇒ `fail`, sans changement d'état. Une résolution valide exige l'exercice légal de `internal` au mode requis. Une compagne `Modify` active bloque les nouvelles compagnes sur l'intégralité du stockage du pool ; des compagnes `Observe` peuvent coexister. Il est impossible de libérer une compagne tant que ses descendantes d'entrée sont actives (O3.2). La propriété d'exclusivité concerne toutes les suites d'opérations admises du noyau, pas seulement deux appels successifs de `resolve`.

`resolveMany(handles, Modify)` crée **une** compagne `Modify` et une autorité `Modify` par entrée. La distinction des slots est vérifiée dynamiquement pour ce lot ; toute identité invalide, génération périmée, entrée libre ou répétition de slot donne `fail` **atomique**, sans création partielle de droits. `resolveMany(handles, Observe)` utilise des dérivations `Observe` de la compagne `Observe`, **sans `split` ni contrôle de distinction** : la répétition du même handle valide est permise. Les `reject` de discipline d'accès restent distincts des `fail` de validation des handles.

`unresolve` libère d'abord toutes les dérivées d'entrée encore actives, puis la compagne. Les règles de `release`, y compris celles qui empêchent la libération en présence de descendants ou d'ancres valides, restent applicables ; le contrat ne supprime pas silencieusement des autorités transférées.

## D.3 — Allocation et fin d'usage de slot

`allocSlot(pool, dst)` exige un pool vivant, l'autorisation d'administration de ses métadonnées, une destination utilisable et libre d'autorité active, non `Init`, apte à recevoir la représentation d'un handle. `fail` si aucun slot libre ; `ok` choisit un slot libre, le rend vivant, conserve sa génération et écrit son handle dans la seule feuille `dst`, selon les obligations de représentation (Spec 4) et d'ABI (Spec 11). **Le contenu du slot demeure `Uninit`** jusqu'à son écriture ; l'écriture du handle dans `dst` n'initialise pas le slot.

`freeSlot(h)` exige un pool **vivant** et `MetaRight`, c'est-à-dire le droit légal d'administration de la valeur pool par `Modify` exerçable ou par mutation `writeShared` admissible de ses métadonnées `SharedMutable`. `fail` si l'identité ou la génération ne correspond pas ; un slot déjà libre n'est pas rendu libérable par cette seule égalité. Pour réussir, la fin logique du contenu doit être admissible : **aucune dépendance utilisable** ne serait invalidée, **aucune feuille n'est épinglée**, et **aucune autorité active ne couvre l'entrée hors `internal` et ses ancêtres**. En particulier, aucune descendante active d'une compagne ne doit subsister sur cette entrée. Le contrôle n'interprète pas `internal` comme un emprunt externe empêchant systématiquement le nettoyage de ses propres slots.

L'effet `ok` applique au **contenu** les effets de fin d'usage d'`endUse`, remet les feuilles de l'entrée à `Uninit`, marque l'entrée libre et incrémente sa génération ; **il ne désalloue pas implicitement l'allocation MM-02 du stockage**. Il ne s'agit pas de supposer une invocation de O12 autorisée par simple `MetaRight` : la correspondance des effets et la préservation des invariants sous ce droit constituent une **obligation explicite de reconstruction**, notamment dans les cas `writeShared`.

## D.4 — Invariant corrigé et limites

`PoolInv` exige : (1) les entrées sont deux à deux disjointes et incluses dans le stockage ; (2) aucune autorité d'entrée active ne désigne un slot libre ou une ancienne génération (`pool_no_stale_access`) ; (3) **garantie de transition** : `freeSlot` n'aboutit jamais si une descendante active d'une compagne couvre le slot concerné. La dernière clause concerne le succès des transitions, non une interdiction globale de toutes les dérivations du noyau sur des slots libres. Les dérivations ordinaires issues d'une autorité d'entrée restent permises par le noyau.

Les générations sont des entiers naturels dans le modèle abstrait. Leur débordement ou leur recyclage dans une représentation finie doivent être empêchés par l'implémentation (par exemple retrait définitif d'un slot) ; l'ABI est spécifiée en Spec 11. L'encapsulation qui empêche un client d'accéder directement à une compagne administrative appartient à la Spec 9. Les handles persistants peuvent représenter des liens cycliques ; les résolutions qui en découlent restent temporaires et soumises à MM-03.

**Statut des preuves :** le jalon 3 rapporte `pool_resolve_modify_exclusive`, `pool_no_stale_access`, `pool_resolveMany_atomic`, `pool_resolveMany_distinct`, `pool_freeSlot_ends_content` et `pool_entries_disjoint` sur son brouillon, sous les hypothèses détaillées dans `J3_v0.1.md`. Il rapporte également un contre-exemple à l'ancienne formulation de `pool_inv_preserved`. **Il ne constitue pas encore la preuve** de la nouvelle règle `freeSlot` sous `MetaRight` ni de la totalité du contrat corrigé : ces obligations sont consignées en annexe F.

4	/-!
5	# Handle pool: a library instance of the access discipline (non-normative)
6	
7	**Non-normative.** This module formalizes the library contract "HandlePool v0.4 annex" (items
8	D.1–D.4), which `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md` does not define (§75, Part XIV
9	preamble: "The contracts of `HandlePool` and `DataStack` belong to their library abstractions and
10	are not defined here"). The normative clauses that constrain it are
11	§36 (`MetaRight` is exercisable `Modify` on the administering value; `writeShared` alone is
12	insufficient), §37 and §89 (handles are data, not authorities), §38 and §46 (library state outside
13	`S₃`), §47 (empty initial registry), §56 (the guard over all registries of live administrations)
14	and §58 (outcomes, statics before `fail`).
15	
16	The pool registry lives beside the kernel state (`PState`). Its operations are built on the
17	kernel operations O1–O16 (§60–§75): `newPool` registers only; `allocSlot` writes the handle into
18	its destination (O10); `resolve` derives a companion from `internal` over the whole storage, then
19	an entry authority from the companion (O1 twice); `resolveMany` does the same with `split` (O2) in
20	`Modify` and with one `Observe` derive per handle (O1) in `Observe`; `unresolve` releases (O3).
21	`freeSlot` applies the effect function of O12 (§69) to the slot content under preconditions that
22	exempt `internal` and its ancestors (`ContentEndPre`): it is not a kernel `endUse` step.
23	`contentEnd_preserves` proves that it preserves `KInv ∧ KAux` (§57); `pstep_kernel` states what
24	every pool step is on the kernel side.
25	-/
26	
27	namespace Ern.Lib.HandlePool
28	
29	open Ern.MemoryModel
30	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access
31	
32	/-! ## Library state (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §38, §46) -/
33	
34	/-- Slot of a pool entry (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1: `{place, gen : Nat, live : Bool}`;
35	non-normative library contract; §38, §46). -/
36	structure Slot where
37	  place : Nat
38	  gen : Nat
39	  live : Bool
40	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
41	
42	/-- Pool entry `{storage, internal, slots}` with its logical identity (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1;
43	non-normative library contract). The pool value is the place holding `internal` (§46 analogue). -/
44	structure Pool where
45	  id : Nat
46	  storage : Nat
47	  internal : Nat
48	  slots : List Slot
49	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
50	
51	/-- Handle `(poolId, slot, gen)`: data, not an authority (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §37, §89;
52	non-normative library contract). -/
53	structure Handle where
54	  id : Nat
55	  slot : Nat
56	  gen : Nat
57	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
58	
59	/-- Ghost record of a resolution (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; auxiliary information creating no
60	right, §38): pool identity and `internal`, the companion, the mode, and the entry authorities
61	tagged with their slot and resolved generation. Read only by `unresolve` and by the invariants. -/
62	structure Res where
63	  pool : Nat
64	  internal : Nat
65	  comp : Nat
66	  mode : Mode
67	  entries : List (Nat × Nat × Nat)
68	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
69	
70	/-- Library state (§38, §46; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; non-normative library contract): the
71	kernel state `S₃` and, separately, the pool registry, the next fresh pool identity and the ghost
72	resolutions. -/
73	structure PState where
74	  kern : S3
75	  pools : List Pool
76	  nId : Nat
77	  res : List Res
78	
79	/-- Initial library state (§47; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1): the initial kernel state, an empty
80	registry. -/
81	def PState.init (statics : Statics) : PState := ⟨S3.init statics, [], 0, []⟩
82	
83	/-- The pool read as an arena entry with nothing available or issued, to reuse `MetaRight` of §36
84	(HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; non-normative library contract). -/
85	def Pool.entry (pl : Pool) : Arena.ArenaEntry := ⟨pl.storage, pl.internal, [], []⟩
86	
87	/-- Administrative right on the pool (§36; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3, corrected by §36;
88	non-normative library contract): the pool is live (`internal` active) and `MetaRight` holds,
89	exercisable `Modify` over the pool value; no `writeShared` branch. -/
90	def AdminRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) : Prop := s.Active pl.internal ∧ Arena.MetaRight s pl.entry
91	
92	/-- Decidability of `AdminRight` (§36). -/
93	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) : Decidable (AdminRight s pl) := by
94	  unfold AdminRight; infer_instance
95	
96	/-- Place of slot `i`, `0` if absent (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; non-normative library
97	contract; §46). -/
98	def slotPlace (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Nat := ((pl.slots[i]?).map (·.place)).getD 0
99	
100	/-- The pool with slot `i` replaced (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; non-normative library
101	contract; §46). -/
102	def setSlot (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : Pool := { pl with slots := pl.slots.set i sl }
103	
104	/-! ## `newPool` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §56) -/
105	
106	/-- The pool registry as a registry of live administrations (§56; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1;
107	non-normative library contract): the `internal` identities of its live pools. -/
108	def liveInternals (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) : List Nat :=
109	  (pools.filter fun pl => decide (s.Active pl.internal)).map (·.internal)
110	
111	/-- Preconditions of `newPool(storage, internal)` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; non-normative
112	library contract; §56, §76). -/
113	structure NewPoolPre (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) (others : List (List Nat))
114	    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
115	  /-- D.1: "reprend les autres obligations applicables de `newArena`" (§76.1–§76.3, §76.5). -/
116	  base : Arena.NewArenaBase s storage internal
117	  /-- D.1: every leaf of the input storage is `Uninit`. -/
118	  uninit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, s.I l = .uninit
119	  /-- D.1, §56: `internal` is absent from the pool registry and from every other registry of live
120	  administrations `others`. -/
121	  guard : Arena.Guard56 (liveInternals s pools :: others) internal
122	
123	/-- Decidability of `NewPoolPre` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §56, §76). -/
124	instance (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
125	    Decidable (NewPoolPre s pools others storage internal) :=
126	  decidable_of_iff (Arena.NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
127	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, s.I l = .uninit) ∧
128	    Arena.Guard56 (liveInternals s pools :: others) internal)
129	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩⟩
130	
131	/-- Effect of `newPool` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; non-normative library contract): a pool with
132	the fresh identity `nId`, one free slot of generation zero per child of the storage, the kernel
133	state unchanged (§46, §76). -/
134	def newPoolEff (L : PState) (storage internal : Nat) : PState :=
135	  { L with
136	    pools := L.pools ++ [⟨L.nId, storage, internal,
137	      (kids L.kern.P storage).map fun q => ⟨q, 0, false⟩⟩]
138	    nId := L.nId + 1 }
139	
140	/-- `newPool` as a relation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §58; non-normative library contract):
141	`ok` or `reject`; `others` are the other registries of live administrations (§56). -/
142	def NewPoolStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (L : PState) :
143	    Outcome3 PState → Prop :=
144	  Guarded (NewPoolPre L.kern L.pools others storage internal) (newPoolEff L storage internal)
145	
146	/-! ## `allocSlot` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3) -/
147	
148	/-- Static preconditions of `allocSlot(pool, dst)` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3, corrected by §36;
149	non-normative library contract). "Apte à recevoir la représentation d'un handle" names no state
150	component and is not represented. -/
151	structure AllocSlotStatic (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
152	  /-- D.3, §36: live pool and `MetaRight`. -/
153	  right : AdminRight s pl
154	  /-- D.3: `dst` is usable. -/
155	  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
156	  /-- D.3: `dst` is a leaf (the handle is written into "la seule feuille `dst`"). -/
157	  dstLeaf : isLeaf s.P dst
158	  /-- D.3 with §67.1: the write of the handle needs exercisable `Modify` over `dst`. -/
159	  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
160	  /-- D.3: `dst` is not `Init`. -/
161	  dstNotInit : s.I dst ≠ .init
162	  /-- D.3: `dst` holds no active authority. -/
163	  dstFree : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
164	    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True
165	
166	/-- Decidability of `AllocSlotStatic` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §36, §67). -/
167	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (AllocSlotStatic s pl dst) :=
168	  decidable_of_iff (AdminRight s pl ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
169	    s.I dst ≠ .init ∧ ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
170	      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True)
171	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩
172	
173	/-- Effect of `allocSlot` on slot `i` of pool `j` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; non-normative
174	library contract): the slot becomes live with its generation kept; the handle is written into the
175	leaf `dst`, which alone becomes `Init` (§67 effect). -/
176	def allocSlotEff (L : PState) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) (dst : Nat) : PState :=
177	  { L with
178	    kern := write3Eff L.kern [dst]
179	    pools := L.pools.set j (setSlot pl i { sl with live := true }) }
180	
181	/-- The handle written by `allocSlot` for slot `i` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; non-normative
182	library contract; §37, §89). -/
183	def slotHandle (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Option Handle :=
184	  (pl.slots[i]?).map fun sl => ⟨pl.id, i, sl.gen⟩
185	
186	/-- `allocSlot(pool j, dst)` as a relation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §58; non-normative library
187	contract): `reject` without the pool or a static precondition; then `fail` when no slot is free;
188	`ok` on any free slot. -/
189	inductive AllocSlotStep (j dst : Nat) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
190	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → AllocSlotStep j dst L .reject
191	  | static {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
192	      AllocSlotStep j dst L .reject
193	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
194	      (∀ sl ∈ pl.slots, sl.live = true) → AllocSlotStep j dst L .fail
195	  | ok {pl : Pool} {i : Nat} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
196	      pl.slots[i]? = some sl → sl.live = false →
197	      AllocSlotStep j dst L (.ok (allocSlotEff L j pl i sl dst))
198	
199	/-! ## `resolve`, `resolveMany` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2) -/
200	
201	/-- The handle designates a live slot of the pool at its generation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2,
202	D.3; §89; non-normative library contract); a slot index outside the pool designates nothing. -/
203	def HandleOK (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Prop :=
204	  h.id = pl.id ∧ OptP (pl.slots[h.slot]?) (fun sl => sl.gen = h.gen ∧ sl.live = true) False
205	
206	/-- Decidability of `HandleOK` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §89). -/
207	instance (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Decidable (HandleOK pl h) := by
208	  unfold HandleOK; infer_instance
209	
210	/-- Legal exercise of `internal` at mode `m` for the companion (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2;
211	non-normative library contract): the preconditions of the `derive` of the companion from
212	`internal` over all leaves of the storage (§60). -/
213	def ResolveRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
214	  DerivePre s pl.internal (footprint s.P pl.storage) m
215	
216	/-- Decidability of `ResolveRight` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §60). -/
217	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Decidable (ResolveRight s pl m) := by
218	  unfold ResolveRight; infer_instance
219	
220	/-- State after the companion (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §60 effect; non-normative library
221	contract): authority `|A|`, derived from `internal` at mode `m` over all leaves of the storage. -/
222	def compS (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
223	  deriveEff s pl.internal (footprint s.P pl.storage) m
224	
225	/-- Observe derivations from `c`, one per region in order (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2:
226	`resolveMany` in `Observe`; §60; non-normative library contract): each accepted in the state left
227	by the previous ones. -/
228	def DerivesPre (s : S3) (c : Nat) : List (List Nat) → Prop
229	  | [] => True
230	  | r :: rs => DerivePre s c r .observe ∧ DerivesPre (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs
231	
232	/-- Decidability of `DerivesPre` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2, §60). -/
233	instance decDerivesPre (s : S3) (c : Nat) :
234	    (rs : List (List Nat)) → Decidable (DerivesPre s c rs)
235	  | [] => isTrue trivial
236	  | r :: rs =>
237	    have := decDerivesPre (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs
238	    inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
239	
240	/-- Effect of the `Observe` derivations from `c`, in order (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §60 effect).
241	-/
242	def derivesEff (s : S3) (c : Nat) : List (List Nat) → S3
243	  | [] => s
244	  | r :: rs => derivesEff (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs
245	
246	/-- Entry authorities of a batch from the companion `c` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; non-normative
247	library contract): `split` (§61) in `Modify`, successive `Observe` derivations (§60) in
248	`Observe`. -/
249	def EntriesPre (k : K) : Mode → S3 → Nat → List (List Nat) → Prop
250	  | .modify, s, c, rs => SplitPre k s c rs
251	  | .observe, s, c, rs => DerivesPre s c rs
252	
253	/-- Decidability of `EntriesPre` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §60, §61). -/
254	instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (m : Mode) (s : S3) (c : Nat)
255	    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (EntriesPre k m s c rs) := by
256	  cases m <;> unfold EntriesPre <;> infer_instance
257	
258	/-- Effect of the entry authorities of a batch (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §60, §61 effects). -/
259	def entriesEff : Mode → S3 → Nat → List (List Nat) → S3
260	  | .modify, s, c, rs => splitEff s c rs
261	  | .observe, s, c, rs => derivesEff s c rs
262	
263	/-- Regions of the entries designated by a batch: the footprint of each slot (HandlePool v0.4
264	annex, D.2; non-normative library contract; §60). -/
265	def entryRegions (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : List (List Nat) :=
266	  hs.map fun h => footprint s.P (slotPlace pl h.slot)
267	
268	/-- Ghost entries of a batch: the `n`-th entry authority is `c + 1 + n`, for slot and generation of
269	the `n`-th handle (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; auxiliary, §38). -/
270	def batchEntries (c : Nat) (hs : List Handle) : List (Nat × Nat × Nat) :=
271	  mapI (fun i h => (i, h.slot, h.gen)) (c + 1) hs
272	
273	/-- `resolve(h, m)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §58; non-normative
274	library contract): `reject` without the pool or the legal exercise of `internal`; then `fail` for
275	a handle of another pool, stale, absent or free; then the companion and the entry authority
276	derived from it, `reject` when the second derivation is not accepted. -/
277	inductive ResolveStep (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (m : Mode) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
278	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → ResolveStep j h m L .reject
279	  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
280	      ResolveStep j h m L .reject
281	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m → ¬ HandleOK pl h →
282	      ResolveStep j h m L .fail
283	  | noEntry {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
284	      HandleOK pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
285	      ¬ DerivePre (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m →
286	      ResolveStep j h m L .reject
287	  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
288	      HandleOK pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
289	      DerivePre (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m →
290	      ResolveStep j h m L (.ok { L with
291	        kern := deriveEff (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m
292	        res := L.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, L.kern.A.length, m,
293	          [(L.kern.A.length + 1, h.slot, h.gen)]⟩] })
294	
295	/-- Validity of a batch (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; non-normative library contract): every handle
296	designates a live slot at its generation; pairwise distinct slots in `Modify` only (§58, §89). -/
297	def BatchOK (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
298	  (∀ h ∈ hs, HandleOK pl h) ∧ (m = .modify → (hs.map (·.slot)).Nodup)
299	
300	/-- Decidability of `BatchOK` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §58, §89). -/
301	instance (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : Decidable (BatchOK pl hs m) := by
302	  unfold BatchOK; infer_instance
303	
304	/-- `resolveMany(hs, m)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §58; non-normative
305	library contract): `reject` without the pool or the legal exercise of `internal`; then an atomic
306	`fail` for an invalid batch; then one companion and the entry authorities (`EntriesPre`), `reject`
307	when they are not accepted. -/
308	inductive ResolveManyStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) (L : PState) :
309	    Outcome3 PState → Prop where
310	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
311	  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
312	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
313	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m → ¬ BatchOK pl hs m →
314	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .fail
315	  | noEntries {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m → BatchOK pl hs m →
316	      ¬ EntriesPre k m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs) →
317	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
318	  | ok {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m → BatchOK pl hs m →
319	      EntriesPre k m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs) →
320	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L (.ok { L with
321	        kern := entriesEff m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs)
322	        res := L.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, L.kern.A.length, m,
323	          batchEntries L.kern.A.length hs⟩] })
324	
325	/-! ## `unresolve` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2) -/
326	
327	/-- Releases the authorities of a list in order (§62); `none` as soon as one release is not
328	accepted (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2: "Les règles de `release` … restent applicables"). -/
329	def releaseAll : S3 → List Nat → Option S3
330	  | s, [] => some s
331	  | s, a :: l => if ReleasePre s a then releaseAll (releaseEff s a) l else none
332	
333	/-- The resolution of companion `c` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; ghost lookup, §38). -/
334	def findRes (L : PState) (c : Nat) : Option Res := L.res.find? fun r => r.comp == c
335	
336	/-- Authorities released by `unresolve` of `r` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; non-normative library
337	contract): the entry authorities still active, then the companion (§62). -/
338	def unresolveList (s : S3) (r : Res) : List Nat :=
339	  ((r.entries.map (·.1)).filter fun a => decide (s.Active a)) ++ [r.comp]
340	
341	/-- `unresolve(c)` as a relation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §58; non-normative library
342	contract): the releases of `unresolveList`; `reject` when one is not accepted or `c` is no
343	companion. -/
344	inductive UnresolveStep (c : Nat) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
345	  | none : findRes L c = none → UnresolveStep c L .reject
346	  | reject {r : Res} : findRes L c = some r → releaseAll L.kern (unresolveList L.kern r) = none →
347	      UnresolveStep c L .reject
348	  | ok {r : Res} {s' : S3} : findRes L c = some r →
349	      releaseAll L.kern (unresolveList L.kern r) = some s' →
350	      UnresolveStep c L (.ok { L with kern := s' })
351	
352	/-! ## `freeSlot` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3) -/
353	
354	/-- `x` is exempt from the end-of-use checks of a slot of the pool of `internal` `i`: `internal` or
355	one of its ancestors (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: "hors `internal` et ses ancêtres"; non-normative
356	library contract; §69). -/
357	def Exempt (s : S3) (i x : Nat) : Prop := x = i ∨ x ∈ s.ancs i
358	
359	/-- Decidability of `Exempt` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §69). -/
360	instance (s : S3) (i x : Nat) : Decidable (Exempt s i x) := by unfold Exempt; infer_instance
361	
362	/-- §69.2 for storage that dies with the content (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: the end-of-use
363	effects of O12; non-normative library contract): an active derived authority over a leaf of a place
364	that stops being usable is held within the slot `q` or by a dying holder. -/
365	def DyingAccessOK (s : S3) (q j : Nat) : Prop :=
366	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
367	    (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, isLeaf s.P l ∧ s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (endUseS s q).Usable l) →
368	      heldIn s.P q y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (endUseS s q) y.holder) True
369	
370	/-- Decidability of `DyingAccessOK` (§69.2). -/
371	instance (s : S3) (q j : Nat) : Decidable (DyingAccessOK s q j) := by
372	  unfold DyingAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance
373	
374	/-- §69.3 with the exemption of D.3 (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; non-normative library contract):
375	anchor `x` of a place remaining usable is not held within the slot `q` and keeps a live holder;
376	unless exempt, it is not a root of `q`. -/
377	def ContentAnchorOK (s : S3) (q i x : Nat) : Prop :=
378	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ heldIn s.P q y.holder ∧ (¬ Exempt s i x → ¬ IsRootOf s q y) ∧
379	    HolderLive (endUseS s q) y.holder) True
380	
381	/-- Decidability of `ContentAnchorOK` (§69.3). -/
382	instance (s : S3) (q i x : Nat) : Decidable (ContentAnchorOK s q i x) := by
383	  unfold ContentAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance
384	
385	/-- Preconditions of the end of the content of slot place `q` of the pool of `internal` `i`
386	(HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: "la fin logique du contenu doit être admissible"; the preconditions
387	of O12, §69, excluding `internal` and its ancestors; non-normative library contract). §69.1 is not
388	a precondition: `freeSlot_modify_right` derives it from `AdminRight`. -/
389	structure ContentEndPre (k : K) (s : S3) (q i : Nat) : Prop where
390	  /-- D.3: no active authority covers the entry except `internal` and its ancestors (§69.2 on the
391	  leaves of the entry, with the exemption). -/
392	  entry : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active j → (∃ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∈ footprint s.P q) →
393	    Exempt s i j
394	  /-- §69.2 on the storage that dies with the content. -/
395	  dying : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, DyingAccessOK s q j
396	  /-- D.3, §69.3: no usable dependency is invalidated. -/
397	  anchors : ∀ q' ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s q).Usable q' →
398	    ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s q).D q', ContentAnchorOK s q i x
399	  /-- D.3, §69.4: no ending leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
400	  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s q l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
401	
402	/-- Decidability of `ContentEndPre` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §69). -/
403	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (q i : Nat) :
404	    Decidable (ContentEndPre k s q i) :=
405	  decidable_of_iff ((∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active j →
406	      (∃ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∈ footprint s.P q) → Exempt s i j) ∧
407	    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, DyingAccessOK s q j) ∧
408	    (∀ q' ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s q).Usable q' →
409	      ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s q).D q', ContentAnchorOK s q i x) ∧
410	    (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s q l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l))
411	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩
412	
413	/-- Effect of `freeSlot` on slot `i` of pool `j` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; non-normative library
414	contract): the effects of O12 on the slot content (`endUseEff`, §69), no deallocation; the slot
415	becomes free and its generation is incremented. -/
416	def freeSlotEff (L : PState) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : PState :=
417	  { L with
418	    kern := endUseEff L.kern sl.place
419	    pools := L.pools.set j (setSlot pl i ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) }
420	
421	/-- `freeSlot(h)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3, corrected by §36; §58;
422	non-normative library contract): `reject` without the pool, without a live pool or `MetaRight`;
423	then `fail` for a handle of another pool, stale, absent or free; then `reject` unless the end of
424	the content is admissible (`ContentEndPre`). -/
425	inductive FreeSlotStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
426	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → FreeSlotStep k j h L .reject
427	  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ AdminRight L.kern pl →
428	      FreeSlotStep k j h L .reject
429	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AdminRight L.kern pl → ¬ HandleOK pl h →
430	      FreeSlotStep k j h L .fail
431	  | noEnd {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AdminRight L.kern pl →
432	      HandleOK pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → ¬ ContentEndPre k L.kern sl.place pl.internal →
433	      FreeSlotStep k j h L .reject
434	  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AdminRight L.kern pl →
435	      HandleOK pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → ContentEndPre k L.kern sl.place pl.internal →
436	      FreeSlotStep k j h L (.ok (freeSlotEff L j pl h.slot sl))
437	
438	/-! ## Library runs (HandlePool v0.4 annex; §38, §46, §57) -/
439	
440	/-- One `ok` step of a library run (HandlePool v0.4 annex; non-normative library contract): a
441	kernel step O1–O16 of non-administrative code, the registry unchanged, or an accepted pool
442	operation (§57, §58). -/
443	inductive PStep (k : K) : PState → PState → Prop where
444	  | kernel {L : PState} {s' : S3} : KStep k L.kern s' → PStep k L { L with kern := s' }
445	  | newPool {L L' : PState} {others : List (List Nat)} {st i : Nat} :
446	      NewPoolStep others st i L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
447	  | allocSlot {L L' : PState} {j dst : Nat} : AllocSlotStep j dst L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
448	  | resolve {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} {m : Mode} :
449	      ResolveStep j h m L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
450	  | resolveMany {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {hs : List Handle} {m : Mode} :
451	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
452	  | unresolve {L L' : PState} {c : Nat} : UnresolveStep c L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
453	  | freeSlot {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} : FreeSlotStep k j h L (.ok L') →
454	      PStep k L L'
455	
456	/-- Library states reachable from the initial library state (§47) by library steps (HandlePool v0.4
457	annex; non-normative library contract). -/
458	inductive PReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : PState → Prop where
459	  | init : PReach k statics (PState.init statics)
460	  | step {L L' : PState} : PReach k statics L → PStep k L L' → PReach k statics L'
461	
462	/-- Library runs in which every step starts from a kernel state satisfying `KInv` (§57; HandlePool
463	v0.4 annex). Under the guarantee of §57 every library-reachable state is such a state
464	(`PReach.toI`); the pool theorems are stated on these runs, so that they do not depend on that
465	guarantee. -/
466	inductive PReachI (k : K) (statics : Statics) : PState → Prop where
467	  | init : PReachI k statics (PState.init statics)
468	  | step {L L' : PState} : PReachI k statics L → KInv L.kern → PStep k L L' →
469	      PReachI k statics L'
470	
471	/-- Kernel side of library runs (§57, §69 effect; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3): a kernel step
472	O1–O16, or the end of the content of a slot place `q` under `ContentEndPre` for some `internal`
473	`i`. -/
474	inductive XStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
475	  | kernel {s s' : S3} : KStep k s s' → XStep k s s'
476	  | contentEnd {s : S3} {q i : Nat} : ContentEndPre k s q i → XStep k s (endUseEff s q)
477	
478	/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` by `XStep` (§57; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3). -/
479	inductive XReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
480	  | init : XReach k statics (S3.init statics)
481	  | step {s s' : S3} : XReach k statics s → XStep k s s' → XReach k statics s'
482	
483	/-- Finite sequences of kernel steps O1–O16 (§57, §58). -/
484	inductive KSeq (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
485	  | refl (s : S3) : KSeq k s s
486	  | tail {s s₁ s₂ : S3} : KSeq k s s₁ → KStep k s₁ s₂ → KSeq k s s₂
487	
488	/-! ## The end of a slot content preserves the kernel invariant (§57, §69; D.3) -/
489	
490	/-- Under `ContentEndPre` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3, §69.3 with the exemption) and `I3` (§52),
491	every anchor of a place usable after `endUseS` stays active after the end of the content. -/
492	theorem contentEnd_anchors {k : K} {s : S3} {q i : Nat} (h3 : I3 s)
493	    (hpre : ContentEndPre k s q i) :
494	    ∀ q', (endUseS s q).Usable q' → ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s q).D q', (endUseEff s q).Active x := by
495	  intro q' hq x hx
496	  have hq₀ := EndFree.endUseS_usable hq
497	  have hx₀ : x ∈ s.D q' := by
498	    simp only [endUseS] at hx; split at hx
499	    · simp at hx
500	    · exact hx
501	  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := h3 q' hq₀ x hx₀
502	  have hc := hpre.anchors q' (List.mem_range.2 hq₀.lt) hq x hx
503	  unfold ContentAnchorOK OptP at hc; rw [hy] at hc
504	  obtain ⟨hnh, -, hl⟩ := hc
505	  exact ⟨y, by rw [endUseEff, EndFree.cleanup_get, EndFree.endUseS_get, hy]; simp [hnh, hl], ya⟩
506	
507	/-- The end of the content preserves `NoDangling` (§54, §69; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3), under
508	`WF3` (§49) and `RootHeldConv` (§40): an active authority on a leaf of a place that stops being
509	usable is derived, and blocked by §69.2 on dying storage, or a root, held by the owner of the root
510	place of the leaf, which stays usable. -/
511	theorem contentEnd_noDangling {k : K} {s : S3} {q i : Nat} (hw : WF3 s) (hnd : NoDangling s)
512	    (ha : RootHeldConv s) (hpre : ContentEndPre k s q i) (hw' : WF3 (endUseEff s q)) :
513	    NoDangling (endUseEff s q) := by
514	  have hU := EndFree.cleanup_usable (endUseS s q)
515	  intro j z hz za q' hq l hl hlz
516	  obtain ⟨hz₀, hnh, hlive⟩ := EndFree.endUse_active hz za
517	  by_cases hq₀ : ¬ s.Usable q'
518	  · exact hnd j z hz₀ za q' hq₀ l hl hlz
519	  replace hq₀ := Decidable.of_not_not hq₀
520	  obtain ⟨-, hleaf, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl

# Report — corpus-lib (brief obligation 7, library part)

Files (new, untracked, nothing committed, no other file touched):
- `formal/Ern/Corpus/LibRunner.lean` (module `Ern.Corpus.LibRunner`, namespace `Ern.Corpus.LibRunner`; imports `Ern.Corpus.Runner`, `Ern.Lib.HandlePool`, `Ern.Lib.DataStack`)
- `formal/Ern/Corpus/Lib.lean` (module `Ern.Corpus.Lib`, namespace `Ern.Corpus.Lib`; imports `Ern.Corpus.LibRunner`)
Both are test modules. No model or library module imports them.

## Status

- `lake build Ern.Corpus.LibRunner Ern.Corpus.Lib`: success. `lake env lean` on both files prints nothing, so there are no warnings. The `decide` proofs of the whole module take about 11 s.
- `axcheck.sh Ern.Corpus.LibRunner Ern.Corpus.Lib`: LibRunner 363 constants / 153 theorems, Lib 64 constants / 25 theorems. Both print `outside propext, Quot.sound: #[]`, so `Classical.choice` is not used.
- No `sorry/admit/native_decide/axiom/noncomputable/set_option`. No line exceeds 100 characters. Every top-level declaration has an English docstring that cites a § clause. Library items also name the contract: "HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.k" or "DS-v1".
- `decide +kernel` was not needed.

## Spec passages implemented

§36 (MetaRight Modify-only, through the library relations), §38, §46, §47 (library state separate from `S₃`, empty registries), §56 and §76.4 (each creation operation consults all other live registries), §57 (reachability of kernel states), §58 (outcomes `ok | reject | fail`), §60–§78 (through `Ern.Corpus.OpRel`), §89. The non-normative contracts are "HandlePool v0.4 annex" D.1–D.3 as corrected by §36 and §56 (through `Ern.Lib.HandlePool`) and DS-v1 (through `Ern.Lib.DataStack`).

## LibRunner (Ern.Corpus.LibRunner)

### Definitions
- `CState ⟨kern, arenas, pools, nId, res, stacks, fresh⟩` holds one kernel state shared by the arena registry, the pool registry with its fresh identity counter and ghost resolutions, and the stack registry with its fresh mark counter. It has projections `toL : LState`, `toP : PState` and `toD : DState`, the setters `setL`, `setP` and `setD`, and `CState.init` (§47).
- Guard parameters for §56:
  - `othersA = [HandlePool.liveInternals, DataStack.stackInternals]`
  - `othersP = [Arena.liveInternals, stackInternals]`
  - `othersD = [Arena.liveInternals, HandlePool.liveInternals]`

  `newArena`, `newPool` and `newStack` receive them as their `others`. Each relation already adds its own registry.
- `COp` has 30 constructors: O1–O16, `newArena`, `issue`, `reset`, `newPool`, `allocSlot`, `resolve`, `resolveMany`, `unresolve`, `freeSlot`, `newStack`, `push`, `mark`, `rewind`, `grow`.
- `CRel k C o` is the relation on the projection the operation acts on, lifted by `LiftR`: `ok C'` iff `C' = emb x` for an `ok x` of the relation.
  - O1–O16, `issue` and `reset` use `Ern.Corpus.OpRel` on `C.toL`. For a kernel op this is the kernel relation on `C.kern` with the arenas unchanged.
  - `newArena` uses `NewArenaStep C.othersA`.
  - Pool operations use `NewPoolStep C.othersP`, `AllocSlotStep`, `ResolveStep`, `ResolveManyStep`, `UnresolveStep` and `FreeSlotStep` on `C.toP`.
  - Stack operations use `NewStackStep C.othersD`, `PushStep`, `MarkStep`, `RewindStep` and `GrowStep` on `C.toD`.
- `cstep k C o` is computable. For kernel and arena ops it is `Ern.Corpus.lstep` on `C.toL`, lifted. It has explicit executors `allocSlotOut`, `resolveOut`, `resolveManyOut`, `unresolveOut`, `freeSlotOut`, `pushOut`, `markOut`, `rewindOut` and `growOut`. `allocSlot` picks the lowest free slot (`firstFree`), which is one of the outcomes the relation allows.
- `cnext`, `crun`, `cfinal`, `CReach` (library reachability under `CRel` `ok` steps), and `CRunsTo k statics os C` with the fields `run`, `creach` and `xreach : HandlePool.XReach k statics C.kern`. `CRuns` is a shorthand.

### Theorems

| Theorem | Statement | Clauses |
|---|---|---|
| `allocSlotOut_sound` … `growOut_sound` (9) | each executor's outcome is an outcome of its library relation (all branches, `ok/reject/fail`) | HandlePool v0.4 annex D.2–D.3; DS-v1; §58 |
| `cstep_sound` | `CRel k C o (cstep k C o)` for every `o` | §58, §60–§78, annex, DS-v1 |
| `crejects` / `cfails` / `coks` | computed `reject` / `fail` / `ok` ⇒ the corresponding outcome of `CRel` (`ok` to `cnext`) | §58 |
| `LStep.kseq` | arena library step ⇒ `KSeq` of kernel steps | Part XIV, §57 |
| `crel_kside` | `ok` step with the `kok` check ⇒ `KSeq` of kernel steps, or (`freeSlot` only) `ContentEndPre ∧ kern' = endUseEff kern q` | §57, §67, §69; D.2, D.3; DS-v1 |
| `crun_reach`, `crunsTo` | a completed run from `CState.init` ⇒ `CReach` and `HandlePool.XReach` (kernel steps + ends of slot contents) | §47, §57 |
| `crun_reachable`, `CRunsTo.reachable` | a completed run with no `freeSlot` ⇒ kernel `Reachable` | §57 |

### What holds on the kernel side (as requested)
- Arena ops (`issue` = `split` + `store`; `reset` = `derive` + `release`; `newArena` none), stack ops (`push` = split+store, `rewind` = split+release, `grow` = release+split+store, `newStack`/`mark` none) and pool ops other than `freeSlot` are kernel-step sequences:
  - `resolve` = 2 `derive`
  - `resolveMany` = `derive` + `split` / `derive`s
  - `unresolve` = `release`s
  - `newPool` = none
  - `allocSlot` = one `write` by an authority found by `writer`
- `freeSlot` is not a kernel step. Its kernel part is `endUseEff` under `ContentEndPre`, which is `HandlePool.XStep.contentEnd`. So a run's kernel state is in `HandlePool.XReach`. It is `Reachable` exactly when the run has no `freeSlot`.

### Runner choices (no verdict changes)
- `crun` also checks `COp.kok`: at an `allocSlot` step, some authority must satisfy `Write3Pre s a [dst]`. Under `KInv` this always holds (`HandlePool.write_of_right`). The check only lets the run prove `XReach` without a `KInv` hypothesis, and no case is affected. Verdicts are always stated with `cstep`/`CRel`, which do not include this check.
- `cfinal` falls back to `CState.init` on an incomplete run. It is used only under `crunsTo`'s hypothesis.

## Cases (Ern.Corpus.Lib)

Notation: "material" = `ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md` (non-normative); "annex" = HandlePool v0.4 annex, corrected by §36 and §56. Every reached state is given by `CRunsTo` (all steps `ok`, `CReach`, `XReach`). Verdicts are stated with the operation's relation on the projected state and decided by `decide`. Twins are runs (`CRuns`).

1	import Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
2	import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.EndFree

4	/-!
5	# Handle pool: a library instance of the access discipline (non-normative)
6	
7	**Non-normative.** This module formalizes the library contract "HandlePool v0.4 annex" (items
8	D.1–D.4), which `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md` does not define (§75, Part XIV
9	preamble: "The contracts of `HandlePool` and `DataStack` belong to their library abstractions and
10	are not defined here"). The normative clauses that constrain it are
11	§36 (`MetaRight` is exercisable `Modify` on the administering value; `writeShared` alone is
12	insufficient), §37 and §89 (handles are data, not authorities), §38 and §46 (library state outside
13	`S₃`), §47 (empty initial registry), §56 (the guard over all registries of live administrations)
14	and §58 (outcomes, statics before `fail`).
15	
16	The pool registry lives beside the kernel state (`PState`). Its operations are built on the
17	kernel operations O1–O16 (§60–§75): `newPool` registers only; `allocSlot` writes the handle into
18	its destination (O10); `resolve` derives a companion from `internal` over the whole storage, then
19	an entry authority from the companion (O1 twice); `resolveMany` does the same with `split` (O2) in
20	`Modify` and with one `Observe` derive per handle (O1) in `Observe`; `unresolve` releases (O3).
21	`freeSlot` applies the effect function of O12 (§69) to the slot content under preconditions that
22	exempt `internal` and its ancestors (`ContentEndPre`): it is not a kernel `endUse` step.
23	`contentEnd_preserves` proves that it preserves `KInv ∧ KAux` (§57); `pstep_kernel` states what
24	every pool step is on the kernel side.
25	-/

27	namespace Ern.Lib.HandlePool
28	
29	open Ern.MemoryModel
30	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

32	/-! ## Library state (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §38, §46) -/
33	
34	/-- Slot of a pool entry (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1: `{place, gen : Nat, live : Bool}`;
35	non-normative library contract; §38, §46). -/
36	structure Slot where
37	  place : Nat
38	  gen : Nat
39	  live : Bool
40	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
41	
42	/-- Pool entry `{storage, internal, slots}` with its logical identity (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1;
43	non-normative library contract). The pool value is the place holding `internal` (§46 analogue). -/
44	structure Pool where
45	  id : Nat
46	  storage : Nat
47	  internal : Nat
48	  slots : List Slot
49	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
50	
51	/-- Handle `(poolId, slot, gen)`: data, not an authority (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §37, §89;
52	non-normative library contract). -/
53	structure Handle where
54	  id : Nat
55	  slot : Nat
56	  gen : Nat
57	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
58	
59	/-- Ghost record of a resolution (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; auxiliary information creating no
60	right, §38): pool identity and `internal`, the companion, the mode, and the entry authorities
61	tagged with their slot and resolved generation. Read only by `unresolve` and by the invariants. -/
62	structure Res where
63	  pool : Nat
64	  internal : Nat
65	  comp : Nat
66	  mode : Mode
67	  entries : List (Nat × Nat × Nat)
68	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
69	
70	/-- Library state (§38, §46; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; non-normative library contract): the
71	kernel state `S₃` and, separately, the pool registry, the next fresh pool identity and the ghost
72	resolutions. -/
73	structure PState where
74	  kern : S3
75	  pools : List Pool
76	  nId : Nat
77	  res : List Res
78	
79	/-- Initial library state (§47; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1): the initial kernel state, an empty
80	registry. -/
81	def PState.init (statics : Statics) : PState := ⟨S3.init statics, [], 0, []⟩
82	
83	/-- The pool read as an arena entry with nothing available or issued, to reuse `MetaRight` of §36
84	(HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; non-normative library contract). -/
85	def Pool.entry (pl : Pool) : Arena.ArenaEntry := ⟨pl.storage, pl.internal, [], []⟩
86	
87	/-- Administrative right on the pool (§36; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3, corrected by §36;
88	non-normative library contract): the pool is live (`internal` active) and `MetaRight` holds,
89	exercisable `Modify` over the pool value; no `writeShared` branch. -/
90	def AdminRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) : Prop := s.Active pl.internal ∧ Arena.MetaRight s pl.entry
91	
92	/-- Decidability of `AdminRight` (§36). -/
93	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) : Decidable (AdminRight s pl) := by
94	  unfold AdminRight; infer_instance
95	
96	/-- Place of slot `i`, `0` if absent (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; non-normative library
97	contract; §46). -/
98	def slotPlace (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Nat := ((pl.slots[i]?).map (·.place)).getD 0
99	
100	/-- The pool with slot `i` replaced (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; non-normative library
101	contract; §46). -/
102	def setSlot (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : Pool := { pl with slots := pl.slots.set i sl }
103	
104	/-! ## `newPool` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §56) -/
105	
106	/-- The pool registry as a registry of live administrations (§56; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1;
107	non-normative library contract): the `internal` identities of its live pools. -/
108	def liveInternals (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) : List Nat :=
109	  (pools.filter fun pl => decide (s.Active pl.internal)).map (·.internal)
110	
111	/-- Preconditions of `newPool(storage, internal)` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; non-normative
112	library contract; §56, §76). -/
113	structure NewPoolPre (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) (others : List (List Nat))
114	    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
115	  /-- D.1: "reprend les autres obligations applicables de `newArena`" (§76.1–§76.3, §76.5). -/
116	  base : Arena.NewArenaBase s storage internal
117	  /-- D.1: every leaf of the input storage is `Uninit`. -/
118	  uninit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, s.I l = .uninit
119	  /-- D.1, §56: `internal` is absent from the pool registry and from every other registry of live
120	  administrations `others`. -/
121	  guard : Arena.Guard56 (liveInternals s pools :: others) internal
122	
123	/-- Decidability of `NewPoolPre` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §56, §76). -/
124	instance (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
125	    Decidable (NewPoolPre s pools others storage internal) :=
126	  decidable_of_iff (Arena.NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
127	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, s.I l = .uninit) ∧
128	    Arena.Guard56 (liveInternals s pools :: others) internal)
129	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩⟩
130	
131	/-- Effect of `newPool` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; non-normative library contract): a pool with
132	the fresh identity `nId`, one free slot of generation zero per child of the storage, the kernel
133	state unchanged (§46, §76). -/
134	def newPoolEff (L : PState) (storage internal : Nat) : PState :=
135	  { L with
136	    pools := L.pools ++ [⟨L.nId, storage, internal,
137	      (kids L.kern.P storage).map fun q => ⟨q, 0, false⟩⟩]
138	    nId := L.nId + 1 }
139	
140	/-- `newPool` as a relation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §58; non-normative library contract):
141	`ok` or `reject`; `others` are the other registries of live administrations (§56). -/
142	def NewPoolStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (L : PState) :
143	    Outcome3 PState → Prop :=
144	  Guarded (NewPoolPre L.kern L.pools others storage internal) (newPoolEff L storage internal)
145	
146	/-! ## `allocSlot` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3) -/
147	
148	/-- Static preconditions of `allocSlot(pool, dst)` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3, corrected by §36;
149	non-normative library contract). "Apte à recevoir la représentation d'un handle" names no state
150	component and is not represented. -/
151	structure AllocSlotStatic (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
152	  /-- D.3, §36: live pool and `MetaRight`. -/
153	  right : AdminRight s pl
154	  /-- D.3: `dst` is usable. -/
155	  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
156	  /-- D.3: `dst` is a leaf (the handle is written into "la seule feuille `dst`"). -/
157	  dstLeaf : isLeaf s.P dst
158	  /-- D.3 with §67.1: the write of the handle needs exercisable `Modify` over `dst`. -/
159	  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
160	  /-- D.3: `dst` is not `Init`. -/
161	  dstNotInit : s.I dst ≠ .init
162	  /-- D.3: `dst` holds no active authority. -/
163	  dstFree : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
164	    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True
165	
166	/-- Decidability of `AllocSlotStatic` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §36, §67). -/
167	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (AllocSlotStatic s pl dst) :=
168	  decidable_of_iff (AdminRight s pl ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
169	    s.I dst ≠ .init ∧ ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
170	      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True)
171	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩
172	
173	/-- Effect of `allocSlot` on slot `i` of pool `j` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; non-normative
174	library contract): the slot becomes live with its generation kept; the handle is written into the
175	leaf `dst`, which alone becomes `Init` (§67 effect). -/
176	def allocSlotEff (L : PState) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) (dst : Nat) : PState :=
177	  { L with
178	    kern := write3Eff L.kern [dst]
179	    pools := L.pools.set j (setSlot pl i { sl with live := true }) }
180	
181	/-- The handle written by `allocSlot` for slot `i` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; non-normative
182	library contract; §37, §89). -/
183	def slotHandle (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Option Handle :=
184	  (pl.slots[i]?).map fun sl => ⟨pl.id, i, sl.gen⟩
185	
186	/-- `allocSlot(pool j, dst)` as a relation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §58; non-normative library
187	contract): `reject` without the pool or a static precondition; then `fail` when no slot is free;
188	`ok` on any free slot. -/
189	inductive AllocSlotStep (j dst : Nat) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
190	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → AllocSlotStep j dst L .reject
191	  | static {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
192	      AllocSlotStep j dst L .reject
193	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
194	      (∀ sl ∈ pl.slots, sl.live = true) → AllocSlotStep j dst L .fail
195	  | ok {pl : Pool} {i : Nat} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
196	      pl.slots[i]? = some sl → sl.live = false →
197	      AllocSlotStep j dst L (.ok (allocSlotEff L j pl i sl dst))
198	
199	/-! ## `resolve`, `resolveMany` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2) -/
200	
201	/-- The handle designates a live slot of the pool at its generation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2,
202	D.3; §89; non-normative library contract); a slot index outside the pool designates nothing. -/
203	def HandleOK (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Prop :=
204	  h.id = pl.id ∧ OptP (pl.slots[h.slot]?) (fun sl => sl.gen = h.gen ∧ sl.live = true) False
205	
206	/-- Decidability of `HandleOK` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §89). -/
207	instance (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Decidable (HandleOK pl h) := by
208	  unfold HandleOK; infer_instance
209	
210	/-- Legal exercise of `internal` at mode `m` for the companion (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2;
211	non-normative library contract): the preconditions of the `derive` of the companion from
212	`internal` over all leaves of the storage (§60). -/
213	def ResolveRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
214	  DerivePre s pl.internal (footprint s.P pl.storage) m
215	
216	/-- Decidability of `ResolveRight` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §60). -/
217	instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Decidable (ResolveRight s pl m) := by
218	  unfold ResolveRight; infer_instance
219	
220	/-- State after the companion (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §60 effect; non-normative library
221	contract): authority `|A|`, derived from `internal` at mode `m` over all leaves of the storage. -/
222	def compS (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
223	  deriveEff s pl.internal (footprint s.P pl.storage) m
224	
225	/-- Observe derivations from `c`, one per region in order (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2:
226	`resolveMany` in `Observe`; §60; non-normative library contract): each accepted in the state left
227	by the previous ones. -/
228	def DerivesPre (s : S3) (c : Nat) : List (List Nat) → Prop
229	  | [] => True
230	  | r :: rs => DerivePre s c r .observe ∧ DerivesPre (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs
231	
232	/-- Decidability of `DerivesPre` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2, §60). -/
233	instance decDerivesPre (s : S3) (c : Nat) :
234	    (rs : List (List Nat)) → Decidable (DerivesPre s c rs)
235	  | [] => isTrue trivial
236	  | r :: rs =>
237	    have := decDerivesPre (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs
238	    inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
239	
240	/-- Effect of the `Observe` derivations from `c`, in order (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §60 effect).
241	-/
242	def derivesEff (s : S3) (c : Nat) : List (List Nat) → S3
243	  | [] => s
244	  | r :: rs => derivesEff (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs
245	
246	/-- Entry authorities of a batch from the companion `c` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; non-normative
247	library contract): `split` (§61) in `Modify`, successive `Observe` derivations (§60) in
248	`Observe`. -/
249	def EntriesPre (k : K) : Mode → S3 → Nat → List (List Nat) → Prop
250	  | .modify, s, c, rs => SplitPre k s c rs
251	  | .observe, s, c, rs => DerivesPre s c rs
252	
253	/-- Decidability of `EntriesPre` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §60, §61). -/
254	instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (m : Mode) (s : S3) (c : Nat)
255	    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (EntriesPre k m s c rs) := by
256	  cases m <;> unfold EntriesPre <;> infer_instance
257	
258	/-- Effect of the entry authorities of a batch (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §60, §61 effects). -/
259	def entriesEff : Mode → S3 → Nat → List (List Nat) → S3
260	  | .modify, s, c, rs => splitEff s c rs
261	  | .observe, s, c, rs => derivesEff s c rs
262	
263	/-- Regions of the entries designated by a batch: the footprint of each slot (HandlePool v0.4
264	annex, D.2; non-normative library contract; §60). -/
265	def entryRegions (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : List (List Nat) :=
266	  hs.map fun h => footprint s.P (slotPlace pl h.slot)
267	
268	/-- Ghost entries of a batch: the `n`-th entry authority is `c + 1 + n`, for slot and generation of
269	the `n`-th handle (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; auxiliary, §38). -/
270	def batchEntries (c : Nat) (hs : List Handle) : List (Nat × Nat × Nat) :=
271	  mapI (fun i h => (i, h.slot, h.gen)) (c + 1) hs
272	
273	/-- `resolve(h, m)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §58; non-normative
274	library contract): `reject` without the pool or the legal exercise of `internal`; then `fail` for
275	a handle of another pool, stale, absent or free; then the companion and the entry authority
276	derived from it, `reject` when the second derivation is not accepted. -/
277	inductive ResolveStep (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (m : Mode) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
278	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → ResolveStep j h m L .reject
279	  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
280	      ResolveStep j h m L .reject
281	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m → ¬ HandleOK pl h →
282	      ResolveStep j h m L .fail
283	  | noEntry {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
284	      HandleOK pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
285	      ¬ DerivePre (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m →
286	      ResolveStep j h m L .reject
287	  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
288	      HandleOK pl h → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
289	      DerivePre (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m →
290	      ResolveStep j h m L (.ok { L with
291	        kern := deriveEff (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m
292	        res := L.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, L.kern.A.length, m,
293	          [(L.kern.A.length + 1, h.slot, h.gen)]⟩] })
294	
295	/-- Validity of a batch (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; non-normative library contract): every handle
296	designates a live slot at its generation; pairwise distinct slots in `Modify` only (§58, §89). -/
297	def BatchOK (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
298	  (∀ h ∈ hs, HandleOK pl h) ∧ (m = .modify → (hs.map (·.slot)).Nodup)
299	
300	/-- Decidability of `BatchOK` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §58, §89). -/
301	instance (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : Decidable (BatchOK pl hs m) := by
302	  unfold BatchOK; infer_instance
303	
304	/-- `resolveMany(hs, m)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §58; non-normative
305	library contract): `reject` without the pool or the legal exercise of `internal`; then an atomic
306	`fail` for an invalid batch; then one companion and the entry authorities (`EntriesPre`), `reject`
307	when they are not accepted. -/
308	inductive ResolveManyStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) (L : PState) :
309	    Outcome3 PState → Prop where
310	  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
311	  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
312	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
313	  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m → ¬ BatchOK pl hs m →
314	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .fail
315	  | noEntries {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m → BatchOK pl hs m →
316	      ¬ EntriesPre k m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs) →
317	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
318	  | ok {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight L.kern pl m → BatchOK pl hs m →
319	      EntriesPre k m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs) →
320	      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L (.ok { L with
321	        kern := entriesEff m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs)
322	        res := L.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, L.kern.A.length, m,
323	          batchEntries L.kern.A.length hs⟩] })
324	
325	/-! ## `unresolve` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2) -/
326	
327	/-- Releases the authorities of a list in order (§62); `none` as soon as one release is not
328	accepted (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2: "Les règles de `release` … restent applicables"). -/
329	def releaseAll : S3 → List Nat → Option S3
330	  | s, [] => some s
331	  | s, a :: l => if ReleasePre s a then releaseAll (releaseEff s a) l else none
332	
333	/-- The resolution of companion `c` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; ghost lookup, §38). -/
334	def findRes (L : PState) (c : Nat) : Option Res := L.res.find? fun r => r.comp == c
335	
336	/-- Authorities released by `unresolve` of `r` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; non-normative library
337	contract): the entry authorities still active, then the companion (§62). -/
338	def unresolveList (s : S3) (r : Res) : List Nat :=
339	  ((r.entries.map (·.1)).filter fun a => decide (s.Active a)) ++ [r.comp]
340	
341	/-- `unresolve(c)` as a relation (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §58; non-normative library
342	contract): the releases of `unresolveList`; `reject` when one is not accepted or `c` is no
343	companion. -/
344	inductive UnresolveStep (c : Nat) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
345	  | none : findRes L c = none → UnresolveStep c L .reject
346	  | reject {r : Res} : findRes L c = some r → releaseAll L.kern (unresolveList L.kern r) = none →
347	      UnresolveStep c L .reject
348	  | ok {r : Res} {s' : S3} : findRes L c = some r →
349	      releaseAll L.kern (unresolveList L.kern r) = some s' →
350	      UnresolveStep c L (.ok { L with kern := s' })
351	
352	/-! ## `freeSlot` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3) -/
353	
354	/-- `x` is exempt from the end-of-use checks of a slot of the pool of `internal` `i`: `internal` or
355	one of its ancestors (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: "hors `internal` et ses ancêtres"; non-normative
356	library contract; §69). -/
357	def Exempt (s : S3) (i x : Nat) : Prop := x = i ∨ x ∈ s.ancs i
358	
359	/-- Decidability of `Exempt` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §69). -/
360	instance (s : S3) (i x : Nat) : Decidable (Exempt s i x) := by unfold Exempt; infer_instance
361	
362	/-- §69.2 for storage that dies with the content (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: the end-of-use
363	effects of O12; non-normative library contract): an active derived authority over a leaf of a place
364	that stops being usable is held within the slot `q` or by a dying holder. -/
365	def DyingAccessOK (s : S3) (q j : Nat) : Prop :=
366	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
367	    (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, isLeaf s.P l ∧ s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (endUseS s q).Usable l) →
368	      heldIn s.P q y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (endUseS s q) y.holder) True
369	
370	/-- Decidability of `DyingAccessOK` (§69.2). -/
371	instance (s : S3) (q j : Nat) : Decidable (DyingAccessOK s q j) := by
372	  unfold DyingAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance
373	
374	/-- §69.3 with the exemption of D.3 (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; non-normative library contract):
375	anchor `x` of a place remaining usable is not held within the slot `q` and keeps a live holder;
376	unless exempt, it is not a root of `q`. -/
377	def ContentAnchorOK (s : S3) (q i x : Nat) : Prop :=
378	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ heldIn s.P q y.holder ∧ (¬ Exempt s i x → ¬ IsRootOf s q y) ∧
379	    HolderLive (endUseS s q) y.holder) True
380	
381	/-- Decidability of `ContentAnchorOK` (§69.3). -/
382	instance (s : S3) (q i x : Nat) : Decidable (ContentAnchorOK s q i x) := by
383	  unfold ContentAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance
384	
385	/-- Preconditions of the end of the content of slot place `q` of the pool of `internal` `i`
386	(HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: "la fin logique du contenu doit être admissible"; the preconditions
387	of O12, §69, excluding `internal` and its ancestors; non-normative library contract). §69.1 is not
388	a precondition: `freeSlot_modify_right` derives it from `AdminRight`. -/
389	structure ContentEndPre (k : K) (s : S3) (q i : Nat) : Prop where
390	  /-- D.3: no active authority covers the entry except `internal` and its ancestors (§69.2 on the
391	  leaves of the entry, with the exemption). -/
392	  entry : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active j → (∃ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∈ footprint s.P q) →
393	    Exempt s i j
394	  /-- §69.2 on the storage that dies with the content. -/
395	  dying : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, DyingAccessOK s q j
396	  /-- D.3, §69.3: no usable dependency is invalidated. -/
397	  anchors : ∀ q' ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s q).Usable q' →
398	    ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s q).D q', ContentAnchorOK s q i x
399	  /-- D.3, §69.4: no ending leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
400	  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s q l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l

## LibRunner (Ern.Corpus.LibRunner)

### Definitions
- `CState ⟨kern, arenas, pools, nId, res, stacks, fresh⟩` holds one kernel state shared by the arena registry, the pool registry with its fresh identity counter and ghost resolutions, and the stack registry with its fresh mark counter. It has projections `toL : LState`, `toP : PState` and `toD : DState`, the setters `setL`, `setP` and `setD`, and `CState.init` (§47).
- Guard parameters for §56:
  - `othersA = [HandlePool.liveInternals, DataStack.stackInternals]`
  - `othersP = [Arena.liveInternals, stackInternals]`
  - `othersD = [Arena.liveInternals, HandlePool.liveInternals]`

  `newArena`, `newPool` and `newStack` receive them as their `others`. Each relation already adds its own registry.
- `COp` has 30 constructors: O1–O16, `newArena`, `issue`, `reset`, `newPool`, `allocSlot`, `resolve`, `resolveMany`, `unresolve`, `freeSlot`, `newStack`, `push`, `mark`, `rewind`, `grow`.
- `CRel k C o` is the relation on the projection the operation acts on, lifted by `LiftR`: `ok C'` iff `C' = emb x` for an `ok x` of the relation.
  - O1–O16, `issue` and `reset` use `Ern.Corpus.OpRel` on `C.toL`. For a kernel op this is the kernel relation on `C.kern` with the arenas unchanged.
  - `newArena` uses `NewArenaStep C.othersA`.
  - Pool operations use `NewPoolStep C.othersP`, `AllocSlotStep`, `ResolveStep`, `ResolveManyStep`, `UnresolveStep` and `FreeSlotStep` on `C.toP`.
  - Stack operations use `NewStackStep C.othersD`, `PushStep`, `MarkStep`, `RewindStep` and `GrowStep` on `C.toD`.
- `cstep k C o` is computable. For kernel and arena ops it is `Ern.Corpus.lstep` on `C.toL`, lifted. It has explicit executors `allocSlotOut`, `resolveOut`, `resolveManyOut`, `unresolveOut`, `freeSlotOut`, `pushOut`, `markOut`, `rewindOut` and `growOut`. `allocSlot` picks the lowest free slot (`firstFree`), which is one of the outcomes the relation allows.
- `cnext`, `crun`, `cfinal`, `CReach` (library reachability under `CRel` `ok` steps), and `CRunsTo k statics os C` with the fields `run`, `creach` and `xreach : HandlePool.XReach k statics C.kern`. `CRuns` is a shorthand.

### What holds on the kernel side (as requested)
- Arena ops (`issue` = `split` + `store`; `reset` = `derive` + `release`; `newArena` none), stack ops (`push` = split+store, `rewind` = split+release, `grow` = release+split+store, `newStack`/`mark` none) and pool ops other than `freeSlot` are kernel-step sequences:
  - `resolve` = 2 `derive`
  - `resolveMany` = `derive` + `split` / `derive`s
  - `unresolve` = `release`s
  - `newPool` = none
  - `allocSlot` = one `write` by an authority found by `writer`
- `freeSlot` is not a kernel step. Its kernel part is `endUseEff` under `ContentEndPre`, which is `HandlePool.XStep.contentEnd`. So a run's kernel state is in `HandlePool.XReach`. It is `Reachable` exactly when the run has no `freeSlot`.

### Runner choices (no verdict changes)
- `crun` also checks `COp.kok`: at an `allocSlot` step, some authority must satisfy `Write3Pre s a [dst]`. Under `KInv` this always holds (`HandlePool.write_of_right`). The check only lets the run prove `XReach` without a `KInv` hypothesis, and no case is affected. Verdicts are always stated with `cstep`/`CRel`, which do not include this check.
- `cfinal` falls back to `CState.init` on an incomplete run. It is used only under `crunsTo`'s hypothesis.

## Observation (contract problem, not a module or kernel defect)

**O1. Ancestor exemption plus identity-only guard lets one pool end another pool's live slot.** Evidence: `pool_two_freeSlot_cross`, conjuncts 5–9.
- Pool 0 has `internal` 5, the root of storage 5. Pool 1 has `internal` 6 on the same storage. Authority 6 is derived `Modify` from 5 and held by leaf 4.
- §56 accepts pool 1, because distinct identities are not forbidden "merely because their footprints overlap".
- `freeSlot` of pool 1's slot 0 (place 6) is `ok`. The exemption of annex D.3 ("hors `internal` et ses ancêtres") covers both 6 and its ancestor 5. Place 6 goes from `Init` to `Uninit`.
- Place 6 is pool 0's slot 0, which is still `live` at generation 0 in pool 0's metadata.

559	    (fun q' pl r hq hp => ?_) (fun q' _ x hx => ?_) (contentEnd_anchors hk.2.1.1.2.2.1 hpre)
560	    (fun r n z pr _ hur hz _ _ hpr hzh _ => ?_)
561	    (contentEnd_noDangling hw hk.2.1.2.2 ha hpre)
562	  · obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hd⟩ := hw.places q' pl r hq hp
563	    simp only [endUseS, hd, decide_eq_decide.2 (EndFree.ownedIn_parent hw hq hp)]
564	  · simp only [endUseS] at hx; split at hx
565	    · simp at hx

570	      rw [hzh] at hh
571	      cases ho : pr.owner with

573	      | place o => rw [ho] at hh; exact hd.2 (.direct hpr ho hh)

628	/-- What a pool step is on the kernel side (HandlePool v0.4 annex; §57, §69): under `KInv`, every
629	step but `freeSlot` is a finite sequence of kernel steps O1–O16 (`newPool` none, `allocSlot` one
630	`write`, `resolve` two `derive`, `resolveMany` one `derive` then one `split` or one `derive` per
631	handle, `unresolve` `release` steps); `freeSlot` is the effect of O12 on the slot content under
632	`ContentEndPre`. -/
633	theorem pstep_kernel {k : K} {L L' : PState} (hk : KInv L.kern) (h : PStep k L L') :
634	    KSeq k L.kern L'.kern ∨
635	      ∃ q i, ContentEndPre k L.kern q i ∧ L'.kern = endUseEff L.kern q := by
636	  cases h with
637	  | kernel hs => exact .inl (KSeq.single hs)
638	  | newPool hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact .inl (.refl _)
639	  | allocSlot hs =>
640	    cases hs with
641	    | ok _ hst _ _ =>
642	      obtain ⟨a, hw⟩ := write_of_right hk hst.dstUsable hst.dstLeaf hst.dstRight
643	      exact .inl (KSeq.single (.write (a := a) (Guarded.ok hw)))
644	  | resolve hs =>
645	    cases hs with
646	    | ok _ hR _ _ hE =>
647	      exact .inl ((KSeq.single (.derive (Guarded.ok hR))).tail (.derive (Guarded.ok hE)))
648	  | resolveMany hs =>
649	    cases hs with
650	    | ok _ hR _ hE => exact .inl ((KSeq.single (.derive (Guarded.ok hR))).trans (entries_kseq hE))
651	  | unresolve hs =>
652	    cases hs with
653	    | ok _ hr => exact .inl (releaseAll_kseq hr)
654	  | freeSlot hs =>
655	    cases hs with
656	    | ok _ _ _ _ hE => exact .inr ⟨_, _, hE, rfl⟩

667	contract and is not proved here: `xreach_inv` reduces it to the preservation of `KInv ∧ KAux` by

674	    (hr : XReach k statics L.kern) (hk : KInv L.kern) (hs : PStep k L L') :
675	    XReach k statics L'.kern := by

681	steps O1–O16 and ends of slot contents (§57; HandlePool v0.4 annex), given `KInv` on such
682	states. -/

684	    {L : PState} (h : PReach k statics L) : XReach k statics L.kern := by
685	  induction h with
686	  | init => exact .init
687	  | step _ hs ih => exact xreach_pstep ih (hX _ ih) hs

689	/-- `KInv ∧ KAux` (§57) holds on every state reached by kernel steps and ends of slot contents,
690	when it holds initially and every kernel step O1–O16 preserves it (`contentEnd_preserves` covers the
691	ends of slot contents; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3). -/
692	theorem xreach_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics}
693	    (h0 : KInv (S3.init statics) ∧ KAux (S3.init statics))
694	    (hK : ∀ s s', KInv s → KAux s → KStep k s s' → KInv s' ∧ KAux s') {s : S3}
695	    (h : XReach k statics s) : KInv s ∧ KAux s := by
696	  induction h with
697	  | init => exact h0
698	  | step _ hs ih =>
699	    cases hs with
700	    | kernel hs => exact hK _ _ ih.1 ih.2 hs
701	    | contentEnd hpre => exact contentEnd_preserves ih.1 ih.2 hpre

/-- The `Init` leaves of the initial state are exactly the statics declared `Init` (§47, §59). -/
theorem init_statics (statics : Statics) (l : Nat) :
    (S3.init statics).I l = .init ↔ ∃ e, statics[l]? = some e ∧ e.2 = true := by
  show (if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then InitSt.init else .uninit) = .init ↔ _
  cases statics[l]? with
  | none => simp
  | some e => cases he : e.2 <;> simp [he]

/-! ## Reachable states (§57) -/

/-- §57 as stated is false: under a contract satisfying `DDSound` (§80) and well-formed statics
(§47), a reachable state violates `KInv`, after an accepted `transfer` (§63,
`transfer_breaks_kinv`). -/
theorem reachable_kinv_false : ¬ ∀ (k : K) (statics : Statics) (s : S3), DDSound k →
    StaticsOK statics → Reachable k statics s → KInv s := by
  intro hall
  obtain ⟨hdd, s, s', hr, -, -, ht, hn⟩ := transfer_breaks_kinv
  exact hn (hall _ _ _ hdd (by decide) (.step hr (.transfer ht)))

/-- A kernel step whose `transfer`, if it is one, leaves its destination usable (§63). The
condition is a hypothesis on runs, not a clause of §63 nor of §57. -/
def KStepDU (k : K) (s s' : S3) : Prop :=
  ∃ op : KernelOp, op.Step k s (.ok s') ∧ ∀ src dst, op = .transfer src dst → s'.Usable dst

/-- States reached from `S3.init statics` by runs whose transfers keep the destination usable
(§57, restricted by the hypothesis of `KStepDU`, which is not a clause of §63). -/
inductive ReachableDU (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  /-- The initial state (§47). -/
  | init : ReachableDU k statics (S3.init statics)
  /-- One more step of `KStepDU` (§57). -/
  | step {s s' : S3} : ReachableDU k statics s → KStepDU k s s' → ReachableDU k statics s'

/-- From a state satisfying `KInv` (§57), `KAux` (§40, §49.7) and `HeldAnchored` under
`DDSound` (§80), the steps of `KStepDU` are exactly the kernel steps whose resulting state
satisfies `KInv`: the restriction of `ReachableDU` keeps exactly the runs along which §57
holds. -/
theorem kstepDU_iff {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) : KStepDU k s s' ↔ KStep k s s' ∧ KInv s' := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨op, hop, hdu⟩
    exact ⟨kstep_iff.2 ⟨op, hop⟩, (op_preserves_of_dst_usable hdd hinv haux hheld hop hdu).1⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, hk⟩
    obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
    refine ⟨op, hop, fun src dst e => ?_⟩
    subst e
    exact transfer_dst_usable_of_noDangling hinv.1 hop hk.2.1.2.2

/-- A state of `ReachableDU` is reachable (§57). -/
theorem ReachableDU.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : ReachableDU k statics s) : Reachable k statics s := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact .init
  | step _ h ih =>
    obtain ⟨op, hop, -⟩ := h
    exact .step ih (kstep_iff.2 ⟨op, hop⟩)

/-- The main invariant of §57 (`WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan`, with `KAux` and
`HeldAnchored`) on the states reached by runs whose transfers keep the destination usable, under
`DDSound` (§80) and well-formed statics (`StaticsOK`, a hypothesis not stated by §47). The
restriction of the runs is not a clause of §63: without it the statement is false
(`reachable_kinv_false`). -/
theorem reachableDU_kinv {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : ReachableDU k statics s) :
    KInv s ∧ KAux s ∧ HeldAnchored s := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact init_kinv hst
  | step _ h ih =>
    obtain ⟨op, hop, hdu⟩ := h
    exact op_preserves_of_dst_usable hdd ih.1 ih.2.1 ih.2.2 hop hdu

/-! ## Initialization history (§59) -/

/-- Operation `op` writes leaf `l` from state `s` (§59): `write3` or `writeShared` of a list
containing `l`, `store` into `l`, or a `transfer` of which `l` is a destination leaf
corresponding to a source leaf `Init` before the step. -/
def KernelOp.Writes (s : S3) (l : Nat) : KernelOp → Prop
  | .write _ ls => l ∈ ls
  | .writeShared _ ls => l ∈ ls
  | .store _ p => l = p
  | .transfer src dst => l ∈ footprint s.P dst ∧
      ∃ l' ∈ footprint s.P src, corr s.P src dst l' = some l ∧ s.I l' = .init
  | _ => False
