/-- The state after `o` from `C` when it is `ok`; `C` otherwise (§58). -/
def cnext (C : CState) (o : COp) : CState :=
  match cstep k C o with
  | .ok C' => C'
  | _ => C

/-- The state reached by `os` from `C` when every step is `ok` and every `allocSlot` handle write
is a kernel write (§58, §67); `none` otherwise. -/
def crun (C : CState) : List COp → Option CState
  | [] => some C
  | o :: os =>
    match cstep k C o with
    | .ok C' => if o.kok C then crun C' os else none
    | _ => none

/-- The state reached by `os` from `CState.init statics` (§47); `CState.init statics` when the run
does not complete (used only under `(crun …).isSome = true`, see `crunsTo`). -/
def cfinal (statics : Statics) (os : List COp) : CState :=
  (crun k (CState.init statics) os).getD (CState.init statics)

end Exec

/-- Combined library states reachable from `CState.init statics` (§47) by `ok` steps of the kernel
and of the three libraries (Part XIV; HandlePool v0.4 annex; DS-v1). -/
inductive CReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : CState → Prop where
  | init : CReach k statics (CState.init statics)
  | step {C C' : CState} {o : COp} : CReach k statics C → CRel k C o (.ok C') →
      CReach k statics C'

section Runs
variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- A run of `os` from `CState.init statics` (§47) has only `ok` steps and reaches `C`; `C` is
library-reachable, and its kernel state is reached by kernel steps O1–O16 and ends of slot contents
(§57; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3). -/
structure CRunsTo (statics : Statics) (os : List COp) (C : CState) : Prop where
  /-- Every step is `ok` and the run ends in `C`. -/
  run : crun k (CState.init statics) os = some C
  /-- `C` is library-reachable. -/
  creach : CReach k statics C
  /-- The kernel state of `C` is reached by kernel steps and ends of slot contents. -/
  xreach : HandlePool.XReach k statics C.kern

/-- The run of `os` from `CState.init statics` has only `ok` steps (§47, §57). -/
abbrev CRuns (statics : Statics) (os : List COp) : Prop :=
  CRunsTo k statics os (cfinal k statics os)

end Runs

/-! ## Step soundness (§58) -/

/-- A computed outcome of a projected relation is an outcome of its lift (§58). -/
theorem liftR_liftO {σ : Type} {R : Outcome3 σ → Prop} {emb : σ → CState} {o : Outcome3 σ}
    (h : R o) : LiftR R emb (liftO emb o) := by
  cases o with
  | ok x => exact ⟨x, h, rfl⟩
  | reject => exact h
  | fail => exact h

/-- An outcome of a guarded projected step read on combined outcomes (§58). -/
theorem liftR_guarded {σ : Type} {p : Prop} [Decidable p] {x : σ} {emb : σ → CState} :
    LiftR (Guarded p x) emb (if p then .ok (emb x) else .reject) := by
  | newPool st i => exact liftR_guarded
  | newStack st i => exact liftR_guarded
  | allocSlot j d => exact liftR_liftO (allocSlotOut_sound _ _ _)
  | resolve j h m => exact liftR_liftO (resolveOut_sound _ _ _ _)
  | resolveMany j hs m => exact liftR_liftO (resolveManyOut_sound _ _ _ _)
  | unresolve c => exact liftR_liftO (unresolveOut_sound _ _)
  | freeSlot j h => exact liftR_liftO (freeSlotOut_sound _ _ _)
  | push j n d => exact liftR_liftO (pushOut_sound _ _ _ _)
  | mark j => exact liftR_liftO (markOut_sound _ _)
  | rewind j m => exact liftR_liftO (rewindOut_sound _ _ _)
  | grow j b e => exact liftR_liftO (growOut_sound _ _ _ _)
  | _ => exact liftR_liftO (lstep_sound _ _)

/-- A computed `reject` is a `reject` outcome of the relation (§58). -/
theorem crejects {C : CState} {o : COp} (h : verdictOf (cstep k C o) = .reject) :
    CRel k C o .reject := by
  have hs := cstep_sound (k := k) C o
  revert hs h
  cases cstep k C o with
  | ok => intro h; cases h
  | reject => intro _ hs; exact hs
  | fail => intro h; cases h

/-- A computed `fail` is a `fail` outcome of the relation (§58). -/
theorem cfails {C : CState} {o : COp} (h : verdictOf (cstep k C o) = .fail) :
    CRel k C o .fail := by
  have hs := cstep_sound (k := k) C o
  revert hs h
  cases cstep k C o with
  | ok => intro h; cases h
  | reject => intro h; cases h
  | fail => intro _ hs; exact hs

/-- A computed `ok` is the `ok` outcome of the relation to `cnext k C o` (§58). -/
theorem coks {C : CState} {o : COp} (h : verdictOf (cstep k C o) = .ok) :
    CRel k C o (.ok (cnext k C o)) := by
  have hs := cstep_sound (k := k) C o
  unfold cnext
  revert hs h
  cases cstep k C o with
  | ok => intro _ hs; exact hs
  | reject => intro h; cases h
  | fail => intro h; cases h

end Sound

/-! ## Kernel side of library steps (§57; Part XIV; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; DS-v1) -/

/-- A sequence of kernel steps from a reachable state ends in a reachable state (§57). -/
theorem reachable_kseq {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s s' : S3} (hr : Reachable k statics s)
    (h : HandlePool.KSeq k s s') : Reachable k statics s' := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact hr
  | tail _ hs ih => exact .step ih hs

/-- The kernel part of an arena library step is a sequence of kernel steps (Part XIV, §57:
`newArena` changes no kernel component, `issue` is `split` then `store`, `reset` is `derive` then
`release`). -/
theorem LStep.kseq {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LStep k L L') :
    HandlePool.KSeq k L.kern L'.kern := by
  cases h with
      split at h
      · next hw =>
        refine crun_reachable ?_ ho.2 h
        rcases crel_kside hs hw with hk | ⟨hf, -⟩
        · exact reachable_kseq hr hk
        · rw [ho.1] at hf; cases hf
      · cases h
    | reject => rw [e] at h; cases h
    | fail => rw [e] at h; cases h

/-- **Run soundness** (§47, §57; Part XIV; HandlePool v0.4 annex; DS-v1): when the run of `os` from
`CState.init statics` completes, it reaches `cfinal k statics os`, which is library-reachable and
whose kernel state is reached by kernel steps O1–O16 and ends of slot contents. -/
theorem crunsTo {statics : Statics} {os : List COp}
    (h : (crun k (CState.init statics) os).isSome = true) : CRuns k statics os := by
  have hr : crun k (CState.init statics) os = some (cfinal k statics os) := by
    unfold cfinal
    cases e : crun k (CState.init statics) os with
    | none => rw [e] at h; cases h
    | some C => rfl
  obtain ⟨hc, hx⟩ := crun_reach .init .init hr
  exact ⟨hr, hc, hx⟩

/-- A completed run without `freeSlot` reaches a kernel-reachable state (§57; Part XIV;
HandlePool v0.4 annex; DS-v1). -/
theorem CRunsTo.reachable {statics : Statics} {os : List COp} {C : CState}
    (h : CRunsTo k statics os C) (ho : os.all COp.kernelOnly = true) :
    Reachable k statics C.kern :=
  crun_reachable .init ho h.run

end RunSound

1908	/-! ## Witnesses on library-reachable states (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2, D.3)
1909	
1910	Runs from `PState.init Witness.hst` under the test contract `Examples.K0` (§48). Statics (§47):
1911	place 0 is the pool storage, with two leaf children 1 and 2 (`Uninit`); place 3 is the pool value
1912	(`Init`); place 4 is a destination (`Uninit`); root authorities 0, 1 and 2 cover places 0, 3 and 4.
1913	`internal` is authority 3, derived from 0 over `[1, 2]` and stored in place 3. Every precondition is
1914	decided by `decide`. -/
1915	
1916	namespace Witness
1917	
1918	open Examples
1919	
1920	/-- Statics of the witnesses (§47; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1). -/
1921	def hst : Statics :=
1922	  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false),
1923	    ((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false)]
1924	
1925	/-- Initial library state (§47). -/
1926	def w0 : PState := PState.init hst
1927	
1928	/-- After `derive(0, [1, 2], Modify)` (§60): authority 3, the future `internal`. -/
1929	def w1 : PState := { w0 with kern := deriveEff w0.kern 0 [1, 2] .modify }
1930	
1931	/-- After `store(3, 3)` (§65): `internal` is held by the pool value, place 3. -/
1932	def w2 : PState := { w1 with kern := storeEff w1.kern 3 3 }
1933	
1934	/-- After `newPool(0, 3)` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1): pool 0 with slots 1 and 2, free, of
1935	generation 0 (§47). -/
1936	def w3 : PState := newPoolEff w2 0 3
1937	
1938	/-- Pool 0 after `newPool` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1; §47). -/
1939	def pl3 : Pool := ⟨0, 0, 3, [⟨1, 0, false⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩
1940	
1941	/-- After `allocSlot(0, 4)` on slot 0 (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3): the handle `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` is
1942	written into place 4 (§47, §67). -/
1943	def w4 : PState := allocSlotEff w3 0 pl3 0 ⟨1, 0, false⟩ 4
1944	
1945	/-- Pool 0 after `allocSlot` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §47). -/
1946	def pl4 : Pool := ⟨0, 0, 3, [⟨1, 0, true⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩
1947	
1948	/-- `w3` is reached by a library run whose steps start from states satisfying `KInv` (§57, §60,
1949	§65; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1). -/
1950	theorem w3_reach : PReachI K0 hst w3 :=
1951	  .step (.step (.step .init (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
1952	    (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide))))) (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
1953	    (.kernel (.store (Guarded.ok (by decide))))) (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
1954	    (.newPool (others := []) (Guarded.ok (by decide)))
1955	
1956	/-- `w4` is library-reachable (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §47, §67). -/
1957	theorem w4_reach : PReachI K0 hst w4 :=
1958	  .step w3_reach (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
1959	    (.allocSlot (.ok (pl := pl3) rfl (by decide) rfl rfl))
1960	
1961	/-- `resolveMany` in `Observe` accepts a repeated valid handle (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2: "la
1962	répétition du même handle valide est permise"): two `Observe` entry authorities on slot 0, derived
1963	from one `Observe` companion; the same batch in `Modify` fails (§60). -/
1964	theorem observe_repeat_ok :
1965	    (∃ L', ResolveManyStep K0 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 0, 0⟩] .observe w4 (.ok L') ∧ PReachI K0 hst L' ∧

1968	  have hok : ResolveManyStep K0 0 [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 0, 0⟩] .observe w4 (.ok _) :=
1969	    .ok (pl := pl4) rfl (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
1970	  exact ⟨⟨_, hok, .step w4_reach (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1 (.resolveMany hok), rfl⟩,
1971	    (pool_resolveMany_distinct (L' := w4) (pl := pl4)).1 rfl (by decide) (by decide)⟩
1972

1974	`internal` comme un emprunt externe"; §69.2): on `w4`, `freeSlot(⟨0, 0, 0⟩)` is accepted, while the

1976	covering place 1) is held by the pool value outside the slot. Both states satisfy `KInv ∧ KAux`

1979	    (∃ L', FreeSlotStep K0 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ w4 (.ok L') ∧ PReachI K0 hst L' ∧
1980	      KInv L'.kern ∧ KAux L'.kern) ∧
1981	      ¬ EndUsePre K0 w4.kern 1 ∧ KInv w4.kern ∧ KAux w4.kern := by
1982	  have hok : FreeSlotStep K0 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ w4 (.ok _) :=
1983	    .ok (pl := pl4) (sl := ⟨1, 0, true⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) rfl (by decide)
1984	  have hk4 : KInv w4.kern ∧ KAux w4.kern := Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)
1985	  exact ⟨⟨_, hok, .step w4_reach hk4.1 (.freeSlot hok), Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)⟩, by decide,
1986	    hk4⟩
1987	
1988	/-- Contract problem (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: "Le contenu du slot demeure `Uninit` jusqu'à son
1989	écriture ; l'écriture du handle dans `dst` n'initialise pas le slot"): the preconditions of

1991	accepted on slot 0, whose place is 1: the slot becomes live and its content `Init` (§67). -/
1992	theorem allocSlot_into_own_slot :
1993	    ∃ L', AllocSlotStep 0 1 w3 (.ok L') ∧ PReachI K0 hst L' ∧
1994	      L'.pools[0]? = some pl4 ∧ L'.kern.I 1 = .init := by
1995	  have hok : AllocSlotStep 0 1 w3 (.ok (allocSlotEff w3 0 pl3 0 ⟨1, 0, false⟩ 1)) :=
1996	    .ok rfl (by decide) rfl rfl
1997	  exact ⟨_, hok, .step w3_reach (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1 (.allocSlot hok), rfl, by decide⟩
1998	
1999	/-- Contract problem (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1: "Les entrées libres sont `Uninit`"): free
2000	entries are not `Uninit` in every library-reachable state. On `w3`, a frame with `Modify` over the
2001	pool value derives from `internal` over slot place 1 (O1, §60) and writes it (O10, §67): slot 0
2002	stays free while its content is `Init`. -/
2003	theorem free_slot_init :
2004	    ∃ L, PReachI K0 hst L ∧ L.pools[0]? = some pl3 ∧ L.kern.I 1 = .init := by
2005	  have h₁ : PStep K0 w3 { w3 with kern := deriveEff w3.kern 3 [1] .modify } :=
2006	    .kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide)))
2007	  have h₂ : PStep K0 { w3 with kern := deriveEff w3.kern 3 [1] .modify }
2008	      { w3 with kern := write3Eff (deriveEff w3.kern 3 [1] .modify) [1] } :=
2009	    .kernel (.write (a := 4) (Guarded.ok (by decide)))
2010	  exact ⟨_, .step (.step w3_reach (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1 h₁)
2011	    (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1 h₂, rfl, by decide⟩
2012	
2013	end Witness

import Ern.Lib.HandlePool

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.Lib.HandlePool Examples

namespace Cx

/-- place 0 storage (children 1, 2), 3 pool value A (Init), 4 pool value B, 5 and 6 handle
destinations. Roots: auth 0 (place 0), 1 (3), 2 (4), 3 (5), 4 (6). -/
def st : Statics :=
  [((none, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false), ((some 0, none, 0), false),
    ((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((none, none, 0), false),
    ((none, none, 0), false)]

def x0 : PState := PState.init st
def x1 : PState := { x0 with kern := deriveEff x0.kern 0 [1, 2] .modify }   -- auth 5
def x2 : PState := { x1 with kern := storeEff x1.kern 5 3 }
def x3 : PState := newPoolEff x2 0 5
def plA : Pool := ⟨0, 0, 5, [⟨1, 0, false⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩
def x4 : PState := allocSlotEff x3 0 plA 0 ⟨1, 0, false⟩ 5
def plA4 : Pool := ⟨0, 0, 5, [⟨1, 0, true⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩
-- resolve(pool 0, ⟨0,0,0⟩, Modify): companion 6, entry 7
def x5 : PState := { x4 with
  kern := deriveEff (compS x4.kern plA4 .modify) x4.kern.A.length (footprint x4.kern.P 1) .modify
  res := x4.res ++ [⟨plA4.id, plA4.internal, x4.kern.A.length, .modify,
    [(x4.kern.A.length + 1, 0, 0)]⟩] }
def x6 : PState := { x5 with kern := releaseEff x5.kern 7 }
def x7 : PState := { x6 with kern := deriveEff x6.kern 6 [1, 2] .modify }  -- auth 8
def x8 : PState := { x7 with kern := storeEff x7.kern 8 4 }
def x9 : PState := newPoolEff x8 0 8
def plB : Pool := ⟨1, 0, 8, [⟨1, 0, false⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩
def x10 : PState := allocSlotEff x9 1 plB 0 ⟨1, 0, false⟩ 6
def plB10 : Pool := ⟨1, 0, 8, [⟨1, 0, true⟩, ⟨2, 0, false⟩]⟩

example : x4.pools[0]? = some plA4 := by decide
example : x9.pools[1]? = some plB := by decide
example : x10.pools[1]? = some plB10 := by decide
example : x10.res = [⟨0, 5, 6, .modify, [(7, 0, 0)]⟩] := by decide

theorem x10_reach : PReachI K0 st x10 := by
  have h1 : PReachI K0 st x1 := .step .init (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
    (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
  have h2 : PReachI K0 st x2 := .step h1 (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
    (.kernel (.store (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
  have h3 : PReachI K0 st x3 := .step h2 (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
    (.newPool (others := []) (Guarded.ok (by decide)))
  have h4 : PReachI K0 st x4 := .step h3 (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
    (.allocSlot (.ok (pl := plA) rfl (by decide) rfl rfl))
  have h5 : PReachI K0 st x5 := .step h4 (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
    (.resolve (.ok (pl := plA4) (sl := ⟨1, 0, true⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) rfl
      (by decide)))
  have h6 : PReachI K0 st x6 := .step h5 (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
    (.kernel (.release (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
  have h7 : PReachI K0 st x7 := .step h6 (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
    (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
  have h8 : PReachI K0 st x8 := .step h7 (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
    (.kernel (.store (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
  have h9 : PReachI K0 st x9 := .step h8 (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
    (.newPool (others := []) (Guarded.ok (by decide)))
  exact .step h9 (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1
    (.allocSlot (.ok (pl := plB) rfl (by decide) rfl rfl))

/-- The literal D.4(3) / brief guarantee ("freeSlot never succeeds on an entry covered by an active
companion descendant"), over every ghost companion, fails on a PReachI state: pool 1 frees slot
place 1 while companion 6 of pool 0 is active and its active descendant 8 covers place 1. -/
theorem literal_guarantee_fails :
    PReachI K0 st x10 ∧ KInv x10.kern ∧
    (∃ L', FreeSlotStep K0 1 ⟨1, 0, 0⟩ x10 (.ok L')) ∧
    (⟨0, 5, 6, .modify, [(7, 0, 0)]⟩ : Res) ∈ x10.res ∧
    x10.kern.Active 6 ∧ x10.kern.Active 8 ∧ 6 ∈ x10.kern.ancs 8 ∧
    1 ∈ x10.kern.afp 8 ∧ 1 ∈ x10.kern.afp 6 ∧ 1 ∈ footprint x10.kern.P 1 ∧
    x10.pools[0]? = some plA4 ∧ x10.kern.I 1 = .uninit := by
  refine ⟨x10_reach, (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1,
    ⟨_, .ok (pl := plB10) (sl := ⟨1, 0, true⟩) rfl (by decide) (by decide) rfl (by decide)⟩,
    by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
    by decide⟩

end Cx

211-  metaRight : MetaRight s E

213-  regionIn : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage

4	/-!
5	# DataStack: a library administrative abstraction (contract DS-v1, non-normative)
6	
7	A `DataStack` instance of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md`. The spec does not define
8	its contract (Part XIV preamble: "The contracts of `HandlePool` and `DataStack` belong to their
9	library abstractions and are not defined here"). The contract formalized here is the library
10	contract **DS-v1**, which is **not normative**: every definition below that encodes a DS-v1 item
11	says so. The normative clauses that constrain it are §36 (`MetaRight` requires `Modify` exercisable
12	on the stack value; the abstraction adds no rights to the kernel), §38 and §46 (library state
13	separate from `S₃`), §47 (empty initial registry), §56 (guard over all registries of live
14	administrations) and §58 (outcomes).
15	
16	DS-v1: marks carry the stack identity and a fresh mark identifier; the stack keeps the ordered list
17	of live marks; `rewind m` fails on a dead or foreign mark, rejects if an active authority derived
18	from `internal` covers a cell above `m`, otherwise returns those cells to available and removes `m`
19	and every mark above it; `push` and `grow` use the derived `issue` of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`: its
20	static checks, the availability `fail`, then `split` of `internal` and `store` of the block); `grow`
21	is in place only (same base, extension into the space directly after the block, `fail` otherwise).
22	
23	Every `ok` step of the library is a sequence of kernel steps O1–O16 (`DReach.reachable`), so the
24	abstraction adds no rights to the kernel (§36).
25	-/
26	
27	namespace Ern.Lib.DataStack
28	
29	open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
30	
31	/-! ## Library state (DS-v1; §38, §46, §47) -/
32	
33	/-- A block issued by a stack (DS-v1, non-normative; recorded like the issuances of §46): position
34	`base` of its first cell and number `size` of cells among the ordered cells of the stack, block
35	authority `auth`, destination `dst` that received it. -/
36	structure Blk where
37	  base : Nat
38	  size : Nat
39	  auth : Nat
40	  dst : Nat
41	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
42	
43	/-- A mark (DS-v1, non-normative: "marks carry stack identity and a fresh mark identifier";
44	library metadata of an administrative abstraction, §36, §38): the identity of its stack, its fresh
45	identifier, the top of the stack when it was taken. -/
46	structure Mark where
47	  stack : Nat
48	  id : Nat
49	  top : Nat
50	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
51	
52	/-- A stack (DS-v1, non-normative; library state, §38, §46): administered storage, `internal`
53	authority held by the stack value (§36), ordered cells (the leaves of the storage at creation),
54	top (the cells at positions `≥ top` are available), issued blocks (oldest first), and the ordered
55	list of live marks (DS-v1: "the stack keeps the ordered list of live marks"). -/
56	structure Stack where
57	  storage : Nat
58	  internal : Nat
59	  cells : List Nat
60	  top : Nat
61	  blocks : List Blk
62	  marks : List Mark
63	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
64	
65	/-- State of the stack library (DS-v1, non-normative; §38: administrative states of library
66	abstractions are separate from `S₃`): the kernel state, the stack registry (a stack is identified
67	by its index; stacks are never removed) and the next fresh mark identifier. -/
68	structure DState where
69	  kern : S3
70	  stacks : List Stack
71	  fresh : Nat
72	
73	/-- Initial state (§47: the kernel's initial state; the library registry starts empty; DS-v1,
74	non-normative: no mark identifier given out). -/
75	def DState.init (statics : Statics) : DState := ⟨S3.init statics, [], 0⟩
76	
77	/-- The `n` cells from position `b` of the stack, leaves of the administered storage (§46; DS-v1,
78	non-normative). -/
79	def cellsOf (st : Stack) (b n : Nat) : List Nat := (st.cells.drop b).take n
80	
81	/-- The cells above mark `m` (DS-v1, non-normative, "a cell above m"; reading recorded; §46
82	available leaves): the positions from the top of `m` to the current top, those that `rewind m`
83	returns to available. -/
84	def above (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : List Nat := cellsOf st m.top (st.top - m.top)
85	
86	/-- The stack seen as an administration entry (§46, §36; DS-v1, non-normative): storage,
87	`internal`, available cells (positions `≥ top`) and issued blocks. Used for `MetaRight` and the
88	static checks of the derived `issue`, which read only the storage and `internal`. -/
89	def Stack.entry (st : Stack) : ArenaEntry :=
90	  ⟨st.storage, st.internal, st.cells.drop st.top,
91	    st.blocks.map fun x => (cellsOf st x.base x.size, x.auth)⟩
92	
93	/-- The block of the stack whose authority is `b` (§46 issuances; DS-v1, non-normative). -/
94	def Stack.block (st : Stack) (b : Nat) : Option Blk := st.blocks.find? fun y => decide (y.auth = b)
95	
96	/-- A live mark of stack `j` (DS-v1, non-normative: a mark that is neither dead nor foreign; it
97	decides the `fail` case of `rewind`, §58): it names stack `j` and belongs to its list of live
98	marks. -/
99	def LiveMark (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Prop := m.stack = j ∧ m ∈ st.marks
100	
101	/-- Decidability of `LiveMark` (§58; DS-v1). -/
102	instance (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Decidable (LiveMark j st m) := by
103	  unfold LiveMark; infer_instance
104	
105	/-- The administrative right of §36 for a stack (DS-v1, non-normative, with §36 and §46 read for a
106	stack): the stack is live (`internal` is active) and `MetaRight`, `Modify` exercisable on the stack
107	value, the place holding `internal`. -/
108	def AdminRight (s : S3) (st : Stack) : Prop := s.Active st.internal ∧ MetaRight s st.entry
109	
110	/-- Decidability of `AdminRight` (§36; DS-v1). -/
111	instance (s : S3) (st : Stack) : Decidable (AdminRight s st) := by
112	  unfold AdminRight; infer_instance
113	
114	/-! ## `newStack` and the guard of §56 -/
115	
116	/-- The stack registry as a registry of live administrations (§56; DS-v1, non-normative): the
117	`internal` identities of its live stacks. -/
118	def stackInternals (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) : List Nat :=
119	  (stacks.filter fun st => decide (s.Active st.internal)).map (·.internal)
120	
121	/-- Preconditions of `newStack(storage, internal)` (DS-v1, non-normative; §56): those of `newArena`
122	other than its guard (`NewArenaBase`, §76.1–§76.3 and §76.5 read for a stack), and the guard of §56
123	over the stack registry and every other registry of live administrations `others`. -/
124	structure NewStackPre (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) (others : List (List Nat))
125	    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
126	  /-- §76.1–§76.3, §76.5, read for a stack (DS-v1). -/
127	  base : NewArenaBase s storage internal
128	  /-- §56: no live administration of any registry uses `internal`. -/
129	  guard : Guard56 (stackInternals s stacks :: others) internal
130	
131	/-- Decidability of `NewStackPre` (§56; DS-v1). -/
132	instance (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
133	    Decidable (NewStackPre s stacks others storage internal) :=
134	  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
135	    Guard56 (stackInternals s stacks :: others) internal)
136	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩
137	
138	/-- Effect of `newStack` (DS-v1, non-normative; §36: registration adds no rights): a stack whose
139	cells are the leaves of the storage, top 0, no block, no mark; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
140	def newStackEff (D : DState) (storage internal : Nat) : DState :=
141	  { D with stacks := D.stacks ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint D.kern.P storage, 0, [], []⟩] }
142	
143	/-- `newStack` as a relation (DS-v1, non-normative; §56, §58): `ok` or `reject`. -/
144	def NewStackStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (D : DState) :
145	    Outcome3 DState → Prop :=
146	  Guarded (NewStackPre D.kern D.stacks others storage internal) (newStackEff D storage internal)
147	
148	/-! ## `push` (DS-v1: the derived `issue`, Part XIV, §77) -/
149	
150	/-- Metadata after `push` (DS-v1, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §77 on §46 metadata): the
151	cells leave the available part (the top rises by `size`), the block is recorded. -/
152	def pushMeta (st : Stack) (size a dst : Nat) : Stack :=
153	  { st with top := st.top + size, blocks := st.blocks ++ [⟨st.top, size, a, dst⟩] }
154	
155	/-- `push(j, size, dst)` (DS-v1, non-normative: "push uses the derived issue"): the derived `issue`
156	of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`) of the `size` cells at the top into `dst`, on the stack seen as an
157	entry: its static checks (`IssueStatic`, §77.1, §77.2, with `MetaRight` of §36), then `fail`, the
158	state unchanged, when fewer than `size` cells are left (availability, §77.4; reading recorded),
159	then `split` of `internal` on the cells (O2) and `store` of the block, of fresh identity `|A|`, into
160	`dst` (O8). -/
161	inductive PushStep (k : K) (j size dst : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
162	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
163	  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
164	      ¬ IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
165	  | fail {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
166	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
167	      ¬ st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length → PushStep k j size dst D .fail
168	  | split {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
169	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
170	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
171	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern .reject →
172	      PushStep k j size dst D .reject
173	  | store {st : Stack} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
174	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
175	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
176	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
177	      StoreStep D.kern.A.length dst s₁ .reject → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
178	  | ok {st : Stack} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
179	      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
180	      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
181	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
182	      StoreStep D.kern.A.length dst s₁ (.ok s₂) →
183	      PushStep k j size dst D
184	        (.ok ⟨s₂, D.stacks.set j (pushMeta st size D.kern.A.length dst), D.fresh⟩)
185	
186	/-! ## `mark` (DS-v1) -/
187	
188	/-- Metadata after `mark` (DS-v1, non-normative; library metadata, §36, §38): a mark naming stack
189	`j`, with the fresh identifier `fresh` and the current top, is appended to the live marks. -/
190	def markMeta (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (fresh : Nat) : Stack :=
191	  { st with marks := st.marks ++ [⟨j, fresh, st.top⟩] }
192	
193	/-- `mark(j)` (DS-v1, non-normative; §58 outcomes; §36: metadata only, no right created): `ok`
194	on an existing stack; the identifier is fresh. -/
195	inductive MarkStep (j : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
196	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → MarkStep j D .reject
197	  | ok {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
198	      MarkStep j D (.ok ⟨D.kern, D.stacks.set j (markMeta j st D.fresh), D.fresh + 1⟩)
199	
200	/-! ## `rewind` (DS-v1) -/
201	
202	/-- Metadata after `rewind m` (DS-v1, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §78 on §46 metadata):
203	the cells above `m` return to available (the top returns to the top of `m`), the blocks from that
204	top are forgotten, `m` and every later mark are removed. -/
205	def rewindMeta (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Stack :=
206	  { st with
207	    top := m.top
208	    blocks := st.blocks.filter fun x => decide (x.base < m.top)
209	    marks := st.marks.takeWhile fun x => decide (x ≠ m) }
210	
211	/-- `rewind(j, m)` (DS-v1, non-normative): `fail`, the state unchanged, on a dead or foreign mark;
212	`reject` without the administrative right of §36; then the derived `reset` of Part XIV on the cells
213	above `m` (reading recorded): `split` of `internal` on them (O2), which rejects when an active
214	authority derived from `internal` covers one of them (`rewind_rejects_live_above`), and `release`
215	of the derived authority (O3); `ok`: the cells return to available, `m` and the later marks are
216	removed. -/
217	inductive RewindStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (m : Mark) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
218	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → RewindStep k j m D .reject
219	  | dead {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → ¬ LiveMark j st m → RewindStep k j m D .fail
220	  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m → ¬ AdminRight D.kern st →
221	      RewindStep k j m D .reject
222	  | split {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m → AdminRight D.kern st →
223	      SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern .reject → RewindStep k j m D .reject
224	  | release {st : Stack} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m →
225	      AdminRight D.kern st → SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
226	      ReleaseStep D.kern.A.length s₁ .reject → RewindStep k j m D .reject
227	  | ok {st : Stack} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark j st m →
228	      AdminRight D.kern st → SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
229	      ReleaseStep D.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) →
230	      RewindStep k j m D (.ok ⟨s₂, D.stacks.set j (rewindMeta st m), D.fresh⟩)
231	
232	/-! ## `grow` (DS-v1: in place, the derived `issue`) -/
233	
234	/-- In-place extension (DS-v1, non-normative: "extension into the space directly after the
235	block"; the availability check of the derived `issue`, §77.4): the block ends at the top, and
236	`extra` available cells follow it. -/
237	def InPlace (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra : Nat) : Prop :=
238	  x.base + x.size = st.top ∧ st.top + extra ≤ st.cells.length
239	
240	/-- Decidability of `InPlace` (§77.4; DS-v1). -/
241	instance (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra : Nat) : Decidable (InPlace st x extra) := by
242	  unfold InPlace; infer_instance
243	
244	/-- The grown block (DS-v1, non-normative: same base, `extra` more cells, new authority `a`, same
245	destination; an issuance of §46). -/
246	def growBlk (x : Blk) (extra a : Nat) : Blk := ⟨x.base, x.size + extra, a, x.dst⟩
247	
248	/-- Metadata after `grow` (DS-v1, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §77 on §46 metadata): the
249	top rises by `extra`; the block is replaced by the grown block. -/
250	def growMeta (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra a : Nat) : Stack :=
251	  { st with
252	    top := st.top + extra
253	    blocks := st.blocks.map fun y => if y.auth = x.auth then growBlk x extra a else y }
254	
255	/-- `grow(j, b, extra)` (DS-v1, non-normative: in place only, using the derived `issue`): `reject`
256	when `b` is not a block of the stack or `extra` is zero (reading recorded); `release` of `b` (O3);
257	then the derived `issue` of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`) of the region of the same base and of size
258	`size + extra` into the recorded destination, on the released state: its static checks
259	(`IssueStatic`, §77.1, §77.2), `fail`, the state unchanged, unless the extension is in place
260	(DS-v1 "fail otherwise", availability §77.4), `split` of `internal` (O2) and `store` of the new
261	block (O8). -/
262	inductive GrowStep (k : K) (j b extra : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
263	  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
264	  | noBlock {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = none →
265	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
266	  | noExtra {st : Stack} {x : Blk} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x → extra = 0 →
267	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
268	  | release {st : Stack} {x : Blk} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x → 0 < extra →
269	      ReleaseStep b D.kern .reject → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
270	  | static {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
271	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
272	      ¬ IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst →
273	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
274	  | fail {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
275	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
276	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst →
277	      ¬ InPlace st x extra → GrowStep k j b extra D .fail
278	  | split {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
279	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
280	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst → InPlace st x extra →
281	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ .reject →
282	      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
283	  | store {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
284	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
285	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst → InPlace st x extra →
286	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ (.ok s₂) →
287	      StoreStep s₁.A.length x.dst s₂ .reject → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
288	  | ok {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ s₂ s₃ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
289	      0 < extra → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
290	      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst → InPlace st x extra →
291	      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ (.ok s₂) →
292	      StoreStep s₁.A.length x.dst s₂ (.ok s₃) →
293	      GrowStep k j b extra D (.ok ⟨s₃, D.stacks.set j (growMeta st x extra s₁.A.length), D.fresh⟩)
294	
295	/-! ## Library runs (DS-v1; §36, §56, §57) -/
296	
297	/-- One `ok` step of the stack library (DS-v1, non-normative): a kernel step O1–O16 of
298	non-administrative code, the registry unchanged; `newStack` with the guard of §56 against the other
299	registries `others`; `push`, `mark`, `rewind`, `grow`. -/
300	inductive DStep (k : K) : DState → DState → Prop where
301	  | kernel {D : DState} {s' : S3} : KStep k D.kern s' → DStep k D ⟨s', D.stacks, D.fresh⟩
302	  | newStack {D D' : DState} {others : List (List Nat)} {storage i : Nat} :
303	      NewStackStep others storage i D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
304	  | push {D D' : DState} {j size dst : Nat} : PushStep k j size dst D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
305	  | mark {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} : MarkStep j D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
306	  | rewind {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} {m : Mark} : RewindStep k j m D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
307	  | grow {D D' : DState} {j b extra : Nat} : GrowStep k j b extra D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
308	
309	/-- States reachable from the initial state by library steps (DS-v1, non-normative; §47). -/
310	inductive DReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : DState → Prop where
311	  | init : DReach k statics (DState.init statics)
312	  | step {D D' : DState} : DReach k statics D → DStep k D D' → DReach k statics D'
313	
314	/-- Finite sequences of library steps (DS-v1, non-normative; §58 `ok` transitions). -/
315	inductive DRun (k : K) : DState → DState → Prop where
316	  | refl (D : DState) : DRun k D D
317	  | tail {D D' D'' : DState} : DRun k D D' → DStep k D' D'' → DRun k D D''
318	
319	/-- The kernel part of a library step is reached by kernel steps (§36: the abstraction adds no
320	rights to the kernel; Part XIV: `issue` is `split` then `store`, the reset part of `rewind` is
321	`split` then `release`; DS-v1). -/
322	theorem DStep.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D D' : DState}
323	    (hr : Reachable k statics D.kern) (h : DStep k D D') : Reachable k statics D'.kern := by
324	  cases h with
325	  | kernel hk => exact .step hr hk
326	  | newStack hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hr
327	  | push hs =>
328	    cases hs with
329	    | ok _ _ _ hsp hst => exact .step (.step hr (.split hsp)) (.store hst)
330	  | mark hs => cases hs with | ok _ => exact hr
331	  | rewind hs =>
332	    cases hs with
333	    | ok _ _ _ hsp hrl => exact .step (.step hr (.split hsp)) (.release hrl)
334	  | grow hs =>
335	    cases hs with
336	    | ok _ _ _ hrl _ _ hsp hst =>
337	      exact .step (.step (.step hr (.release hrl)) (.split hsp)) (.store hst)
338	
339	/-- The kernel state of every library-reachable state is kernel-reachable (§36, §57; DS-v1). -/
340	theorem DReach.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D : DState} (h : DReach k statics D) :
341	    Reachable k statics D.kern := by
342	  induction h with
343	  | init => exact .init
344	  | step _ hs ih => exact hs.reachable ih

349	theorem getElem?_set_cases {α : Type} {l : List α} {j i : Nat} {v x : α}

352	  by_cases hij : j = i
353	  · subst hij; simp only [↓reduceIte] at h; split at h
354	    · cases h; exact .inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
355	    · cases h
356	  · simp only [hij, ↓reduceIte] at h; exact .inr ⟨Ne.symm hij, h⟩

363	  split at h

483	    (hsub : st'.marks.Sublist st.marks) (hf : D.fresh ≤ D'.fresh) : MarksWF D' := by
484	  intro i st'' h
485	  rw [hs] at h
486	  rcases getElem?_set_cases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
487	  · exact ⟨(hw _ st hst).1.sublist hsub, fun m hm => by
488	      have := (hw _ st hst).2 m (hsub.subset hm); exact ⟨this.1, by omega⟩⟩
489	  · exact ⟨(hw i st'' h).1, fun m hm => by
490	      have := (hw i st'' h).2 m hm; exact ⟨this.1, by omega⟩⟩

496	    (hsub : ∀ x ∈ st'.marks, x ∈ st.marks) (hf : D.fresh ≤ D'.fresh) : Gone D' m := by
497	  refine ⟨by have := hg.1; omega, fun i st'' h hm => ?_⟩
498	  rw [hs] at h
499	  rcases getElem?_set_cases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩

501	  · exact hg.2 i st'' h hm

503	/-- Every library step keeps `MarksWF` (DS-v1; §38 library metadata). -/
504	theorem DStep.marksWF {k : K} {D D' : DState} (h : DStep k D D') (hw : MarksWF D) :
505	    MarksWF D' := by
506	  cases h with
507	  | kernel => exact hw
508	  | newStack hs =>
509	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
510	    intro i st h
511	    rcases getElem?_append_single h with h | rfl
512	    · exact hw i st h
513	    · exact ⟨List.nodup_nil, fun m hm => by simp at hm⟩
514	  | push hs =>
515	    cases hs with
516	    | ok hst => exact marksWF_set hw hst rfl (List.Sublist.refl _) (Nat.le_refl _)
517	  | rewind hs =>
518	    cases hs with
519	    | ok hst => exact marksWF_set hw hst rfl (List.takeWhile_sublist _) (Nat.le_refl _)
520	  | grow hs =>
521	    cases hs with
522	    | ok hst => exact marksWF_set hw hst rfl (List.Sublist.refl _) (Nat.le_refl _)
523	  | mark hs =>
524	    cases hs with
525	    | ok hst =>
526	      rename_i st
527	      intro i st' h
528	      rcases getElem?_set_cases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
529	      · obtain ⟨hnd, hms⟩ := hw _ st hst
530	        refine ⟨List.nodup_append.2 ⟨hnd, List.nodup_cons.2 ⟨by simp, List.nodup_nil⟩,
531	          fun a ha b hb e => ?_⟩, fun m hm => ?_⟩

533	          exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ (hms _ ha).2
534	        · rcases List.mem_append.1 hm with hm | hm
535	          · exact ⟨(hms m hm).1, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (hms m hm).2⟩
536	          · rw [List.mem_singleton] at hm; subst hm; exact ⟨rfl, Nat.lt_succ_self _⟩
537	      · exact ⟨(hw i st' h).1, fun m hm =>
538	          ⟨((hw i st' h).2 m hm).1, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt ((hw i st' h).2 m hm).2⟩⟩

676	    rw [hst] at hst₀; cases hst₀; rw [hx] at hx₀; cases hx₀
677	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hrl
678	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp
679	    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsto
680	    intro l hl
681	    have hblk := split_block (releaseEff D.kern b) st.internal (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra))
682	    have hlr : l ∈ (splitEff (releaseEff D.kern b) st.internal
683	        [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)]).afp (releaseEff D.kern b).A.length := by
684	      simp only [S3.afp, hblk]; exact (cellsOf_prefix st x.base x.size extra).subset hl
685	    have hne : l ≠ x.dst := fun he =>
686	      (hpre.noCover l hlr).1 (by rw [he]; exact mem_footprint_self hpre.usable hpre.leaf)
687	    rw [storeEff_eq hblk]
688	    simp only [hne, ↓reduceIte]
689	    show (releaseEff D.kern b).I l = _; rw [releaseEff_I]

691	/-! ## Bytes of the old block after `grow` (refinement, §82) -/
692	
693	/-- A raw write into the range of leaf `d` leaves the bytes of the range of a leaf `l` in another
694	allocation or with a disjoint range unchanged (§16 ¶3, §82.1; support for DS-v1 `grow`). -/
695	theorem bytesOf_write_other {s2 : Machine.State} {L : Refinement.Layout} {l d : Nat}
696	    {w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat}
697	    (hd : (L l).alloc ≠ (L d).alloc ∨
698	      Machine.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L d).off (L d).len)
699	    {i : Nat} (hi : i < (L l).len) :
700	    Refinement.bytesOf (s2.write (Refinement.leafAcc s2 L .write d) w) L l i =
701	      Refinement.bytesOf s2 L l i := by
702	  unfold Refinement.bytesOf
703	  rw [Refinement.write_allocs]
704	  by_cases heq : (L l).alloc = (L d).alloc
705	  · have hr := hd.resolve_left (· heq)
706	    simp only [Refinement.leafAcc, heq, ↓reduceIte]
707	    cases ha : s2.allocs (L d).alloc with
708	    | none => rfl
709	    | some a =>
710	      simp only [Option.map_some, Refinement.leafAddr, Refinement.baseOf_of ha,
711	        Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
712	      rw [Machine.Alloc.write_bytes_out]
713	      intro ⟨h1, h2⟩
714	      exact hr ((L l).off + i) (Nat.le_add_right _ _) (Nat.add_lt_add_left hi _) h1 h2
715	  · simp only [Refinement.leafAcc, heq, ↓reduceIte]
716	
717	/-- `grow_keeps_prefix_bytes` (DS-v1, non-normative; through the refinement of Part XVII, §82): an
718	`ok` of `grow b extra` is the kernel steps `release(b)`, `split(internal, [region])` and
719	`store(|A|, dst)`; their realization in the memory machine (`Refinement.opsOf`) has no raw
720	operation for `release` and `split` (§62, §61), and the raw operations of `store` (one write into
721	the range of the destination, §82.3) leave the bytes, values and provenances, of every cell of the
722	old block unchanged, for every layout satisfying the layout interface `LayoutWF` (§82.1, §23) in
723	the state before the step. -/
724	theorem grow_keeps_prefix_bytes {Ty : Type} {k : K} {D D' : DState} {j b extra : Nat}
725	    (h : GrowStep k j b extra D (.ok D')) {st : Stack} {x : Blk} (hst : D.stacks[j]? = some st)
726	    (hx : st.block b = some x) :
727	    ∃ s₁ s₂, Refinement.OpStep k (.release b) D.kern s₁ ∧
728	      Refinement.OpStep k (.split st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)]) s₁ s₂ ∧
729	      Refinement.OpStep k (.store D.kern.A.length x.dst) s₂ D'.kern ∧
730	      ∀ (π : Refinement.Params Ty) (s2 : Machine.State), Refinement.LayoutWF π.L D.kern s2 →
731	        Refinement.opsOf π (.release b) D.kern s2 = [] ∧
732	        Refinement.opsOf π (.split st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)]) s₁ s2 = [] ∧
733	        ∀ l ∈ cellsOf st x.base x.size, ∀ i < (π.L l).len,
734	          Refinement.bytesOf
735	            (Refinement.run s2 (Refinement.opsOf π (.store D.kern.A.length x.dst) s₂ s2)) π.L l i =
736	          Refinement.bytesOf s2 π.L l i := by
737	  cases h with
738	  | @ok st₀ x₀ s₁ s₂ s₃ hst₀ hx₀ hpos hrl hstat hin hsp hsto =>
739	    rw [hst] at hst₀; cases hst₀; rw [hx] at hx₀; cases hx₀
740	    have hlen : s₁.A.length = D.kern.A.length := by
741	      rw [(Guarded.ok_iff.1 hrl).2]; exact releaseEff_len D.kern b
742	    have hP₁ : s₁.P = D.kern.P := by rw [(Guarded.ok_iff.1 hrl).2]; exact releaseEff_P D.kern b
743	    have hP₂ : s₂.P = D.kern.P := by rw [(Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp).2, ← hP₁]; rfl
744	    rw [hlen] at hsto
745	    refine ⟨s₁, s₂, hrl, hsp, hsto, fun π s2 hlw => ⟨rfl, rfl, fun l hl i hi => ?_⟩⟩
746	    obtain ⟨hpre, -⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsto
747	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp
748	    have hblk := split_block s₁ st.internal (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra))
749	    rw [hlen] at hblk
750	    have hlr' : l ∈ cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra) :=
751	      (cellsOf_prefix st x.base x.size extra).subset hl
752	    have hlr : l ∈ (splitEff s₁ st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)]).afp
753	        D.kern.A.length := by simp only [S3.afp, hblk]; exact hlr'
754	    have hne : l ≠ x.dst := fun he =>
755	      (hpre.noCover l hlr).1 (by rw [he]; exact mem_footprint_self hpre.usable hpre.leaf)
756	    obtain ⟨hlP, hlleaf, -⟩ := mem_footprint.1 (hstat.regionIn l hlr')
757	    rw [hP₁] at hlP hlleaf
758	    have hdP : x.dst < D.kern.P.length := hP₂ ▸ hpre.usable.lt
759	    have hdleaf : isLeaf D.kern.P x.dst := hP₂ ▸ hpre.leaf
760	    have hdis : (π.L l).alloc ≠ (π.L x.dst).alloc ∨
761	        Machine.RangeDisjoint (π.L l).off (π.L l).len (π.L x.dst).off (π.L x.dst).len := by
762	      by_cases ha : (π.L l).alloc = (π.L x.dst).alloc
763	      · exact .inr (hlw.disjoint l x.dst hlP hdP hlleaf hdleaf hne ha)
764	      · exact .inl ha
765	    simp only [Refinement.opsOf, Refinement.storeOps]
766	    split
767	    · exact bytesOf_write_other hdis hi
768	    · rfl

770	/-! ## Non-vacuity: a concrete run (DS-v1)
771	
772	A run from `DState.init wst` under the test contract `Access.Examples.K0` (§48). Statics (§47):
773	leaf 0 (`Init`) is the stack value; place 1 is the storage, with the cells 2 and 3; leaves 4 and 5
774	are destinations; root authorities 0, 1, 2, 3 on the roots 0, 1, 4, 5, held by frame 0. Every
775	precondition is decided by `decide`. -/
776	
777	namespace Witness
778	
779	open Examples
780	
781	/-- The statics of the run (§47; DS-v1 non-vacuity): stack value 0, storage 1 with cells 2 and 3,
782	destinations 4 and 5. -/
783	def wst : Statics :=
784	  [((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((some 1, none, 0), false),
785	    ((some 1, none, 0), false), ((none, none, 0), false), ((none, none, 0), false)]
786	
787	/-- Initial state (§47; DS-v1 non-vacuity). -/
788	def d0 : DState := DState.init wst
789	/-- `derive(1, [2, 3], Modify)`: authority 4, held by frame 0 (§60; DS-v1 non-vacuity). -/
790	def d1 : DState := ⟨deriveEff d0.kern 1 [2, 3] .modify, d0.stacks, d0.fresh⟩
791	/-- `store(4, 0)`: authority 4 becomes `internal`, held by the stack value 0 (§65; DS-v1
792	non-vacuity). -/
793	def d2 : DState := ⟨storeEff d1.kern 4 0, d1.stacks, d1.fresh⟩
794	/-- `newStack(1, 4)` (DS-v1, §56). -/
795	def d3 : DState := newStackEff d2 1 4
796	/-- The stack registered by `newStack(1, 4)` (DS-v1, §46). -/
797	def st3 : Stack := ⟨1, 4, footprint d2.kern.P 1, 0, [], []⟩
798	/-- `mark(0)`: mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` (DS-v1, §58). -/
799	def d4 : DState := ⟨d3.kern, d3.stacks.set 0 (markMeta 0 st3 d3.fresh), d3.fresh + 1⟩
800	/-- The stack after the first mark (DS-v1, §46). -/
801	def st4 : Stack := markMeta 0 st3 d3.fresh
802	/-- `push(0, 1, 4)`: `split(4, [[2]])`, `store(5, 4)` (DS-v1, Part XIV, §77). -/
803	def d5 : DState :=
804	  ⟨storeEff (splitEff d4.kern st4.internal [cellsOf st4 st4.top 1]) d4.kern.A.length 4,
805	    d4.stacks.set 0 (pushMeta st4 1 d4.kern.A.length 4), d4.fresh⟩
806	/-- The stack after the first push: block `⟨0, 1, 5, 4⟩` (DS-v1, §46). -/
807	def st5 : Stack := pushMeta st4 1 d4.kern.A.length 4
808	/-- `mark(0)`: mark `⟨0, 1, 1⟩` (DS-v1, §58). -/
809	def d6 : DState := ⟨d5.kern, d5.stacks.set 0 (markMeta 0 st5 d5.fresh), d5.fresh + 1⟩
810	/-- The stack after the second mark (DS-v1, §46). -/
811	def st6 : Stack := markMeta 0 st5 d5.fresh
812	/-- `push(0, 1, 5)`: `split(4, [[3]])`, `store(6, 5)` (DS-v1, Part XIV, §77). -/
813	def d7 : DState :=
814	  ⟨storeEff (splitEff d6.kern st6.internal [cellsOf st6 st6.top 1]) d6.kern.A.length 5,
815	    d6.stacks.set 0 (pushMeta st6 1 d6.kern.A.length 5), d6.fresh⟩
816	/-- The stack after the second push: blocks `⟨0, 1, 5, 4⟩`, `⟨1, 1, 6, 5⟩` (DS-v1, §46). -/
817	def st7 : Stack := pushMeta st6 1 d6.kern.A.length 5
818	/-- `release(6)` by the program (§62; DS-v1 non-vacuity). -/
819	def d8 : DState := ⟨releaseEff d7.kern 6, d7.stacks, d7.fresh⟩
820	/-- The second mark (DS-v1, §58). -/
821	def m1 : Mark := ⟨0, 1, 1⟩
822	/-- `rewind(0, ⟨0, 1, 1⟩)`: `split(4, [[3]])`, `release(7)` (DS-v1, §61, §62). -/
823	def d9 : DState :=
824	  ⟨releaseEff (splitEff d8.kern st7.internal [above st7 m1]) d8.kern.A.length,
825	    d8.stacks.set 0 (rewindMeta st7 m1), d8.fresh⟩
826	/-- The stack after the rewind (DS-v1, §46). -/
827	def st9 : Stack := rewindMeta st7 m1
828	/-- The block of authority 5 (DS-v1, §46). -/
829	def x5 : Blk := ⟨0, 1, 5, 4⟩
830	/-- `grow(0, 5, 1)`: `release(5)`, `split(4, [[2, 3]])`, `store(8, 4)` (DS-v1, Part XIV,
831	§77). -/
832	def d10 : DState :=
833	  ⟨storeEff (splitEff (releaseEff d9.kern 5) st9.internal [cellsOf st9 x5.base (x5.size + 1)])
834	      (releaseEff d9.kern 5).A.length x5.dst,
835	    d9.stacks.set 0 (growMeta st9 x5 1 (releaseEff d9.kern 5).A.length), d9.fresh⟩
836	
837	/-- The run up to the second push is library-reachable (DS-v1; §47, Part XIV derived `issue`,
838	§77). -/
839	theorem d7_reach : DReach K0 wst d7 := by
840	  have r1 : DReach K0 wst d1 := .step .init (.kernel (.derive (.ok (by decide))))
841	  have r2 : DReach K0 wst d2 := .step r1 (.kernel (.store (.ok (by decide))))
842	  have r3 : DReach K0 wst d3 := .step r2 (.newStack (others := []) (.ok (by decide)))
843	  have r4 : DReach K0 wst d4 := .step r3 (.mark (.ok (st := st3) (by decide)))
844	  have r5 : DReach K0 wst d5 := .step r4
845	    (.push (.ok (st := st4) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
846	      (.ok (by decide))))
847	  have r6 : DReach K0 wst d6 := .step r5 (.mark (.ok (st := st5) (by decide)))
848	  exact .step r6
849	    (.push (.ok (st := st6) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
850	      (.ok (by decide))))
851	
852	/-- The run up to the rewind is library-reachable (DS-v1; §62, Part XIV derived `reset`, §78). -/
853	theorem d9_reach : DReach K0 wst d9 :=
854	  .step (.step d7_reach (.kernel (.release (.ok (by decide)))))
855	    (.rewind (.ok (st := st7) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
856	      (.ok (by decide))))
857	
858	/-- **Non-vacuity of the DS-v1 operations** (§58 outcomes). In `d7`, `rewind ⟨0, 1, 1⟩` is
859	rejected: block 6, derived from `internal` 4, covers cell 3 above the mark
860	(`rewind_rejects_live_above`); `grow` of block 5, which is not at the top, fails (DS-v1 "fail
861	otherwise"). After the program releases 6, `rewind ⟨0, 1, 1⟩` is `ok`: the top returns to 1,
862	the older mark stays; the removed mark then fails (`mark_no_aba`). `grow` of block 5 by one cell
863	is then `ok` in place: block `⟨0, 2, 8, 4⟩`, whose authority 8 covers the cells 2 and 3. -/
864	theorem run_ok :
865	    DReach K0 wst d10 ∧
866	    RewindStep K0 0 m1 d7 .reject ∧ GrowStep K0 0 5 1 d7 .fail ∧
867	    d9.stacks = [⟨1, 4, [2, 3], 1, [x5], [⟨0, 0, 0⟩]⟩] ∧ RewindStep K0 0 m1 d9 .fail ∧
868	    d10.stacks = [⟨1, 4, [2, 3], 2, [⟨0, 2, 8, 4⟩], [⟨0, 0, 0⟩]⟩] ∧ d10.kern.afp 8 = [2, 3] := by
869	  have r10 : DReach K0 wst d10 := .step d9_reach
870	    (.grow (.ok (st := st9) (x := x5) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
871	      (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))))
872	  have hrej := (rewind_rejects_live_above (k := K0) (D := d7) (j := 0) (st := st7) (m := m1)
873	    (x := 6) (l := 3) (y := ⟨.modify, some 4, [3], .place 5, true⟩) (by decide) (by decide)
874	    (by decide) rfl (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)).1
875	  have hfail : GrowStep K0 0 5 1 d7 .fail :=
876	    .fail (st := st7) (x := x5) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (by decide)
877	      (by decide)
878	  exact ⟨r10, hrej, hfail, by decide, (rewind_dead_fails (st := st9) (by decide) (by decide)).1,
879	    by decide, by decide⟩
880	
881	/-! ### Readings with a changed verdict (DS-v1)
882	
883	Each theorem below shows, on a library-reachable state, a program whose verdict depends on a
884	reading of DS-v1 recorded in the readings: the verdict of the reading formalized here, and the
885	facts that make the other reading give another verdict. -/
886	
887	/-- `release(5)` by the program, after the rewind (§62; DS-v1 non-vacuity). -/
888	def d11 : DState := ⟨releaseEff d9.kern 5, d9.stacks, d9.fresh⟩
889	/-- `derive(4, [3], Modify)` by the program: authority 8 on cell 3, above the current top (§60;
890	DS-v1 reading of "above"). -/
891	def d12 : DState := ⟨deriveEff d11.kern 4 [3] .modify, d11.stacks, d11.fresh⟩
892	/-- The first mark (DS-v1, §58). -/
893	def m0 : Mark := ⟨0, 0, 0⟩
894	/-- A callee frame with no parameter and no local, entered after the rewind (§72; DS-v1 reading
895	of the order of `fail` and the right of §36). -/
896	def d13 : DState := ⟨enterEff d9.kern [] [], d9.stacks, d9.fresh⟩
897	
898	/-- **Reading of "a cell above m"** (DS-v1, §46). In `d12`, authority 8, active and derived from
899	`internal` 4, covers cell 3, at a position above the top of mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` but above the current
900	top too, hence not among the cells `rewind` returns (`above`): `rewind ⟨0, 0, 0⟩` is `ok`. Under the
901	reading "any cell at a position at or above the top of `m`", it is rejected. -/
902	theorem reading_above :
903	    DReach K0 wst d12 ∧ d12.kern.A[8]? = some ⟨.modify, some 4, [3], .frame 0, true⟩ ∧
904	    st9.internal ∈ d12.kern.ancs 8 ∧ 3 ∈ st9.cells.drop m0.top ∧ 3 ∉ above st9 m0 ∧
905	    ∃ D', RewindStep K0 0 m0 d12 (.ok D') := by
906	  have r11 : DReach K0 wst d11 := .step d9_reach (.kernel (.release (.ok (by decide))))
907	  have r12 : DReach K0 wst d12 := .step r11 (.kernel (.derive (.ok (by decide))))
908	  exact ⟨r12, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide,
909	    ⟨_, .ok (st := st9) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))⟩⟩
910	
911	/-- **Readings of the order of checks and of `extra = 0`** (DS-v1, §58, §36). (1) In `d13`, a callee
912	with no right on the stack value (`¬ AdminRight`) rewinds to the removed mark `⟨0, 1, 1⟩`: the
913	outcome is `fail` (dead mark checked first); with the right of §36 checked first it is `reject`.
914	(2) In `d9`, `grow(0, 5, 0)` is rejected (`extra = 0`), while the sequence `release`, static checks,
915	in-place check, `split`, `store` of the same region would be `ok`. (3) In `d3`, `push(0, 3, 4)` asks
916	for more cells than the storage has: `fail` (availability), although the requested cells are not all
917	in the storage. -/
918	theorem reading_order :
919	    DReach K0 wst d13 ∧ ¬ AdminRight d13.kern st9 ∧ RewindStep K0 0 m1 d13 .fail ∧
920	    GrowStep K0 0 5 0 d9 .reject ∧
921	    ReleaseStep 5 d9.kern (.ok (releaseEff d9.kern 5)) ∧
922	    IssueStatic (releaseEff d9.kern 5) st9.entry (cellsOf st9 x5.base (x5.size + 0)) x5.dst ∧
923	    InPlace st9 x5 0 ∧
924	    SplitStep K0 st9.internal [cellsOf st9 x5.base (x5.size + 0)] (releaseEff d9.kern 5)
925	      (.ok (splitEff (releaseEff d9.kern 5) st9.internal [cellsOf st9 x5.base (x5.size + 0)])) ∧
926	    StoreStep (releaseEff d9.kern 5).A.length x5.dst
927	      (splitEff (releaseEff d9.kern 5) st9.internal [cellsOf st9 x5.base (x5.size + 0)])
928	      (.ok (storeEff (splitEff (releaseEff d9.kern 5) st9.internal
929	        [cellsOf st9 x5.base (x5.size + 0)]) (releaseEff d9.kern 5).A.length x5.dst)) ∧
930	    PushStep K0 0 3 4 d3 .fail := by
931	  have r13 : DReach K0 wst d13 := .step d9_reach (.kernel (.enter (.ok (by decide))))
932	  exact ⟨r13, by decide, .dead (st := st9) (by decide) (by decide),
933	    .noExtra (st := st9) (x := x5) (by decide) (by decide) rfl, .ok (by decide), by decide,
934	    by decide, .ok (by decide), .ok (by decide),
935	    .fail (st := st3) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)⟩
936	
937	end Witness
938	
939	end Ern.Lib.DataStack

73-  /-- §82.1 (parts): a structural part lies in the allocation of its parent. -/
74-  parts : ∀ q r, parentOf s3.P q = some r → (L q).alloc = (L r).alloc
75-  /-- §23, §82.1 (disjointness): two distinct leaves in one allocation have disjoint ranges. -/
76-  disjoint : ∀ l l', l < s3.P.length → l' < s3.P.length → isLeaf s3.P l → isLeaf s3.P l' →
77-    l ≠ l' → (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc →
78-    Machine.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len
79-  /-- §82.1, §15 ¶1: the range of a leaf lies within its allocation, which is registered. -/
80-  within : ∀ l, l < s3.P.length → isLeaf s3.P l →
81-    AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size
82-
83-/-- Elements of a parent chain lie in the allocation of its start (§82.1 parts, §40). -/
84-theorem alloc_chainF {L : Layout} {P : List Place}
85-    (hp : ∀ q r, parentOf P q = some r → (L q).alloc = (L r).alloc) :
86-    ∀ k i r, r ∈ chainF (parentOf P) k i → (L i).alloc = (L r).alloc

121:structure Repr (L : Layout) (rtok : Nat → Nat) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) : Prop where
122-  /-- §9 ¶8: admissibility of the memory state. -/
123-  adm : Machine.Admissible s2
124-  /-- §82.1, §23: layout interface. -/
125-  layout : LayoutWF L s3 s2
126-  /-- §82.1, §9 ¶5: distinct root places, distinct allocations. -/
127-  inj : ∀ r r', RootPlace s3.P r → RootPlace s3.P r' → r ≠ r' → (L r).alloc ≠ (L r').alloc
128-  /-- §82.4, §17 ¶4: the allocation of a root place is registered with the token `rtok r`. -/
129-  tokens : ∀ r, RootPlace s3.P r → AllocP s2 (L r).alloc fun a => a.freeAuth = some (rtok r)
130-  /-- §82.5: the allocation of a usable root place is live. -/

  /-- §77.1: the entry is live; `internal` is active. -/
  live : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §77.1: `MetaRight`, exercisable `Modify` over the arena value (§36). -/
  metaRight : MetaRight s E
  /-- §77.2: `region` belongs to the administered storage. -/
  regionIn : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §77.2: `destination` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
  /-- §77.2: `destination` is a leaf. -/
  dstLeaf : isLeaf s.P dst
  /-- §77.2: `destination` holds no active authority. -/
  dstFree : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,

  /-- §77.2: `destination` can legally receive the block value in mode `Modify`. -/
  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst

def IssueRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s E.internal l) .modify

import Ern.Lib.HandlePool
import Ern.Lib.DataStack
import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! (a) `KernelGuarantee` is false for `K0` and the statics of `transfer_breaks_kinv`,
although `K0` satisfies `DDSound`. -/

theorem reach_xreach {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    Ern.Lib.HandlePool.XReach k statics s := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact .init
  | step _ hs ih => exact .step ih (.kernel hs)

theorem not_kernelGuarantee :
    DDSound Examples.K0 ∧ ¬ Ern.Lib.HandlePool.KernelGuarantee Examples.K0 TransferWitness.cycStatics := by
  obtain ⟨hdd, s, s', hr, -, -, ht, hn⟩ := transfer_breaks_kinv
  exact ⟨hdd, fun hX => hn (hX s' (.step (reach_xreach hr) (.kernel (.transfer ht))))⟩

/-! (b) Dead pool: a handle whose pool identity is that of a pool no longer live gives `reject`
(only outcome), not `fail`, although the handle passes `HandleOK`. -/
namespace DeadPool
open Ern.Lib.HandlePool Ern.Lib.HandlePool.Witness Examples

def wd : PState := { w4 with kern := releaseEff w4.kern 3 }

theorem wd_reach : PReachI K0 hst wd :=
  .step w4_reach (Arena.KInvB.sound (by decide)).1 (.kernel (.release (Guarded.ok (by decide))))

theorem dead_pool_rejects :
    PReachI K0 hst wd ∧ wd.pools[0]? = some pl4 ∧ ¬ wd.kern.Active 3 ∧ HandleOK pl4 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ ∧
    ResolveStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .observe wd .reject ∧
    (∀ o, ResolveStep 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .observe wd o → o = .reject) := by
  refine ⟨wd_reach, by decide, by decide, by decide, .noRight (pl := pl4) (by decide) (by decide),
    fun o ho => ?_⟩
  cases ho with
  | noPool h => rfl
  | noRight => rfl
  | fail _ hR => exact absurd hR (by decide)
  | noEntry => rfl
  | ok _ hR => exact absurd hR (by decide)
end DeadPool

/-! (c) DataStack R7: after a transfer of the block value, `grow` stores the grown block into the
recorded (moved-from) destination, not where the block value now is. -/
namespace GrowMoved
open Ern.Lib.DataStack Ern.Lib.DataStack.Witness Examples

def e6 : DState := ⟨transferEff d5.kern 4 5, d5.stacks, d5.fresh⟩

example : TransferStep K0 4 5 d5.kern (.ok (transferEff d5.kern 4 5)) := Guarded.ok (by decide)

def xb : Blk := ⟨0, 1, 5, 4⟩

example : e6.kern.A[5]?.map (·.holder) = some (.place 5) := by decide
example : e6.kern.I 4 = .moved := by decide

def e7 : DState :=
  ⟨storeEff (splitEff (releaseEff e6.kern 5) st5.internal [cellsOf st5 xb.base (xb.size + 1)])
      (releaseEff e6.kern 5).A.length xb.dst,
    e6.stacks.set 0 (growMeta st5 xb 1 (releaseEff e6.kern 5).A.length), e6.fresh⟩

theorem grow_after_transfer :
    DReach K0 wst e6 ∧ GrowStep K0 0 5 1 e6 (.ok e7) ∧
    e6.kern.A[5]?.map (·.holder) = some (.place 5) ∧
    e7.kern.A[e6.kern.A.length]?.map (·.holder) = some (.place 4) ∧ e6.kern.I 4 = .moved := by
  have r4 : DReach K0 wst d4 := by
    have r1 : DReach K0 wst d1 := .step .init (.kernel (.derive (.ok (by decide))))
    have r2 : DReach K0 wst d2 := .step r1 (.kernel (.store (.ok (by decide))))
    have r3 : DReach K0 wst d3 := .step r2 (.newStack (others := []) (.ok (by decide)))
    exact .step r3 (.mark (.ok (st := st3) (by decide)))
  have r5 : DReach K0 wst d5 := .step r4
    (.push (.ok (st := st4) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
      (.ok (by decide))))
  have r6 : DReach K0 wst e6 := .step r5 (.kernel (.transfer (Guarded.ok (by decide))))
  exact ⟨r6, .ok (st := st5) (x := xb) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
      (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)), by decide, by decide,
    by decide⟩
end GrowMoved

#print axioms not_kernelGuarantee
#print axioms DeadPool.dead_pool_rejects
#print axioms GrowMoved.grow_after_transfer

**Scope covered.** I reviewed formal/Ern/Lib/HandlePool.lean against Annex D, corrected by spec §36, §56 and brief obligation 5. I reviewed formal/Ern/Lib/DataStack.lean against DS-v1 (brief obligation 6).

**Checks that passed:**
- Every brief theorem exists and is non-vacuous: its hypotheses are met by PReachI or DReach witnesses decided with `decide`.
- PoolInv is defined as EntriesDisjoint ∧ NoStale ∧ FreeGuarantee.
- The stale, other-pool, atomicity and distinctness results match D.2 and D.3, given the recorded readings H-R2, H-R3 and H-R9.
- pool_freeSlot_ends_content and pool_freeSlot_under_modify state the endUse effect under the Modify right. §69.1 is derived from AdminRight.
- The six DataStack theorems state DS-v1 as quoted. grow_keeps_prefix_bytes goes through Refinement.opsOf, and its only hypothesis is LayoutWF.
- The §56 guards are `Guard56 (own live registry :: others)`. The `others` parameter is existential in PStep and DStep, which can only add rejections.

- **HP-4:** freeSlot is a transition outside O1–O16. That conflicts with §36 "add no rights to the kernel" and with §89. The brief prescribes it, but the conflict is not reported.

(R6) mark requires no right, so a frame with no access to the stack value can append marks to its metadata. The alternative based on §36 ¶1 (metadata modified "to the extent permitted by the applicable rights") gives reject. (R7) grow stores the grown block into the recorded Blk.dst even after the block value has been transferred away. The arrival state then differs from the alternative of using the current holder: the block's authority ends up in the moved-from place, which store makes Init, and leaves the place that actually holds the block value. findings.claim: The theorem that is supposed to discharge the transition guarantee proves a weaker statement than the obligation, and nothing records the difference. FreeGuarantee only quantifies over ghost companions of the same pool (`r.pool = pl.id`). D.4(3) has no such restriction: "freeSlot n'aboutit jamais si une descendante active d'une compagne couvre le slot concerné". Neither does the brief: "transition guarantee that freeSlot never succeeds on an entry covered by an active companion descendant". Read literally, the guarantee is false on a PReachI state that satisfies KInv. pool_resolve_modify_exclusive is restricted in the same way (`r₁.pool = r₂.pool`), and the literal D.2 sentence ("Une compagne Modify active bloque les nouvelles compagnes sur l'intégralité du stockage du pool") fails too. readings/handlepool.md has no entry for this narrowing, and no report lists it as a contract problem. Observation O1 in corpus-lib.md covers only the side where a slot's content is ended.

Setup:
- Statics: storage 0 with slots 1 and 2, value A = 3, value B = 4, handle leaves 5 and 6.
- internal 5 is derived from root 0 and stored in 3. newPool(0,5) creates pool 0. allocSlot(0,5) makes slot 0 (place 1) live.
- resolve(⟨0,0,0⟩, Modify) gives companion 6 and entry 7. The kernel releases 7.
- The kernel derives 6 → 8 over [1,2] in Modify and stores 8 into 4.
- newPool(0,8) creates pool 1. The §56 guard accepts it because 8 ≠ 5. allocSlot(1,6) follows.

`Cx.literal_guarantee_fails` decides all of these on state x10:
- PReachI K0 st x10 and KInv x10.kern hold.
- ∃ L', FreeSlotStep K0 1 ⟨1,0,0⟩ x10 (.ok L') holds.
- ⟨0,5,6,.modify,[(7,0,0)]⟩ ∈ x10.res, Active 6, Active 8, 6 ∈ ancs 8, 1 ∈ afp 8, and 1 ∈ afp 6 all hold.
- Pool 0 still lists slot place 1 as live: x10.pools[0]? = some ⟨0,0,5,[⟨1,0,true⟩,…]⟩.

So pool 1's freeSlot succeeds while companion 6 (pool 0's active Modify companion) and its active descendant 8 cover the slot. 8 is exempt only because it is pool 1's own internal, and 6 is one of its ancestors (D.3 exemption).

`Cx.two_modify_companions`: resolve(1, ⟨1,0,0⟩, Modify) on x10 is ok. The result is PReachI, and companions 6 (pool 0) and 9 (pool 1) are both active Modify authorities with afp = [1,2].

FreeGuarantee holds only because of its `r.pool = pl.id` filter. The literal reading needs arbitration: either restrict the D.3 exemption, or restate D.4(3) per pool and record that choice.

findings.claim: Brief obligation 5 is proved only on runs in PReachI, and the docstrings present that domain in a misleading way. KernelGuarantee is called "the guarantee of §57", but it drops §57's DDSound(K) hypothesis, and it is refuted for K0, which satisfies DDSound. So the route the docstrings advertise, "with PReach.toI, on every library-reachable state under the guarantee of §57", is closed in that case. The step hypothesis hK of xreach_inv is also false for K0, so the reduction is vacuous on the corpus contract. pool_resolve_modify_exclusive says it holds "whatever its kernel steps", but PReachI excludes every step taken from a non-KInv kernel state, for example the continuation of a run after the cyclic transfer of §63. The limitation is honestly listed as open item #1 in reports/handlepool.md. It is absent from readings/handlepool.md, and the docstrings read as if the obligation were discharged for every library-reachable state.

findings.claim: A handle that designates a pool which is no longer live (its internal is inactive) gets `reject` from resolve, and `reject` is the only outcome. This holds even though the handle passes HandleOK against the registry entry. §89 says "a stale identity or generation leads to defined failure", and D.1 says a destroyed pool's identity does not reactivate old handles. Neither H-R3 nor H-R4 mentions §89 or the dead-pool case, so the conflict with a normative clause is unrecorded.

findings.claim: The libraries were checked against §36's "add no rights to the kernel". DataStack satisfies it: DReach.reachable shows every library-reachable kernel state is kernel-reachable.
